// Main-screen P0. Only changes the flow into/out of the existing simulation.
let ssSavedWorldAtBoot=false;
function ssIsTitle(){return $('startScreen').classList.contains('visible');}
function ssShowView(id){
 for(const view of ['ssHome','ssSettingsView','ssConfirmView'])$(view).hidden=view!==id;
 const focus={ssHome:'ssContinue',ssSettingsView:'ssSound',ssConfirmView:'ssConfirmCreate'};
 if(id==='ssSettingsView')ssSyncSettings();
 const target=$(focus[id]);if(target&&!target.disabled)target.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function ssUpdateSummary(){
  const has=ssSavedWorldAtBoot,issue=!!ssSaveReadIssue,rawAvailable=issue&&typeof ssSaveReadIssue.raw==='string';
  $('ssContinue').disabled=!has;
  $('ssBackup').hidden=!(has||rawAvailable);
  $('ssBackup').textContent=rawAvailable?'↓ 문제 있는 저장 원본 백업':'↓ 저장 월드 백업';
  $('ssSaveStatus').textContent=issue?'저장 기록 확인 필요':has?'저장된 모험 발견':'새 모험 준비 완료';
  if(issue){
   $('ssSaveInfo').textContent='저장 기록을 안전하게 읽지 못했어요';
   $('ssSaveHint').textContent=rawAvailable?'기존 기록을 지우지 않았어요. 먼저 원본 JSON을 백업해 주세요.':'저장소 접근에 실패했어요. 브라우저 설정을 확인하세요.';
  }else if(has){
   const level=deriveLevelFromTotalXp(game.character.totalXp).level;
   $('ssSaveInfo').textContent=`광부 Lv.${level} · 채굴 ${game.mined||0}블록`;
   $('ssSaveHint').textContent=`월드 시드 ${game.seed} · 코인 ${game.coins} · ${ssLivingFromLegacy?'운영 저장 읽기 전용 (실험본은 별도 저장)':'실험본 이어하기 가능'}`;
  }else{
   $('ssSaveInfo').textContent='아직 저장된 월드가 없어요';
   $('ssSaveHint').textContent='새 월드를 만들면 탐험을 시작할 수 있어요.';
  }
  $('ssConfirmBackup').hidden=!(has||rawAvailable);
  $('ssConfirmBackup').textContent=rawAvailable?'↓ 문제 있는 저장 원본 백업':'↓ 기존 월드 파일 백업';
   $('ssOverwriteWarning').textContent=issue?'저장 파일을 읽지 못했어요. 먼저 원본 JSON을 백업하세요. 이 후보는 운영 저장 키에 쓰지 않아요.':has?(ssLivingFromLegacy?'기존 운영 월드는 보존돼요. 실험본의 새 월드만 별도 키에 저장합니다.':'기존 실험본 저장 기록이 덮어써집니다. 먼저 실험본을 백업하세요.'):'새로운 월드와 기본 장비로 실험을 시작합니다. 운영 저장은 변경하지 않아요.';
 }

function ssSyncSettings(){
 $('ssBgmToggle').textContent=ssBgm.enabled?'켜짐':'꺼짐';$('ssBgmToggle').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(ssBgm.enabled));
 $('ssBgmVolume').value=Math.round(ssBgm.volume*100);
 $('ssSound').textContent=sfxState.enabled?'켜짐':'꺼짐';$('ssSound').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(sfxState.enabled));
 $('ssVolume').value=Math.round(sfxState.volume*100);
 $('ssHaptics').textContent=ropeHapticsEnabled?'켜짐':'꺼짐';$('ssHaptics').setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(ropeHapticsEnabled));
 $('ssRopeAB').textContent=ropeABMode==='A'?'A · 고정':'B · 탄성';$('ssRopeAB').setAttribute('aria-label',`로프 물리 ${ropeABMode==='A'?'고정':'탄성'} 모드, 터치하여 전환`);
}
let ssGuideActive=false,ssGuideStep=0,ssGuideStageAt=0;
const SS_GUIDE_STEPS=[
 '이동: 왼쪽 방향패드(PC는 A/D 또는 방향키)로 이동해 보세요.',
 '채굴: 오른쪽 8방향 채굴 패드를 누른 채 방향을 움직여 연속 채굴하세요. PC는 F를 길게 누를 수 있어요.',
  '로프: PC는 커서 방향에서 우클릭 발사·재클릭 해제(R도 유지), Shift+우클릭 재연결. 실험 T키로 고정/탄성 비교. 모바일은 로프 버튼을 사용하세요.',
 '새 지역: 마을 X55의 별광을 조사한 뒤 X64 숲길을 따라 잔빛숲에 들어가세요. 기존 장터와 광산은 그대로 이용할 수 있어요.'
];
function ssGuideRender(){
 $('tip').classList.toggle('dismissed',!ssGuideActive);
 $('ssGuideActions').hidden=!ssGuideActive;
 if(ssGuideActive){$('tip').querySelector('.k').textContent=`첫 탐험 안내 · ${ssGuideStep+1}/4`;$('tiptext').textContent=SS_GUIDE_STEPS[ssGuideStep];$('ssGuideNext').textContent=ssGuideStep>=3?'완료':'다음';}
}
function ssGuideStart(){ssGuideActive=true;ssGuideStep=0;ssGuideStageAt=performance.now();ssGuideRender();}
function ssGuideStop(){ssGuideActive=false;ssGuideRender();}
function ssGuideNext(){if(!ssGuideActive)return;if(++ssGuideStep>=SS_GUIDE_STEPS.length)ssGuideStop();else {ssGuideStageAt=performance.now();ssGuideRender();}}
function ssGuideTick(now){if(ssGuideActive&&!paused&&now-ssGuideStageAt>12000)ssGuideNext();}
function ssQuickGuide(){showModal('조작 도움말',`<p>처음 1분 동안 이 순서로 조작해 보세요.</p>${SS_GUIDE_STEPS.map((s,i)=>`<div class="line"><strong>${i+1}. ${s}</strong></div>`).join('')}<div class="line"><small>시설 앞에서는 오른쪽 ‘입장’ 버튼을 눌러 보세요. 길이 막히면 ☰ → 긴급 구조를 이용할 수 있어요.</small></div>`);}
$('ssGuideNext').onclick=ssGuideNext;$('ssGuideSkip').onclick=ssGuideStop;
function ssEnterWorld(){
 $('startScreen').classList.remove('visible');$('app').classList.remove('ss-at-title');
 paused=false;ssSavedWorldAtBoot=true;last=performance.now();ssM1SyncHUD();
 ssBgmStart(); // entered through the user's Continue/Create click; no autoplay on page load
   tryAwardEarnedArtifacts();updHud();farmWorldRestoreAfterContinue();archWorldRestoreAfterContinue();
  if(game.mined===0)ssGuideStart();else ssGuideStop();
 $('ssContinue').blur();
}
function ssReturnToTitle(){
 // The in-game modal may be open here. Save the existing world, never regenerate it.
 if(!saveGame(true)){flash('저장 실패: 월드 파일 내보내기를 권장해요.');}
 closeModal();ssSavedWorldAtBoot=true;
 ssUpdateSummary();$('app').classList.add('ss-at-title');$('startScreen').classList.add('visible');paused=true;
 ssBgmStop(); // title screen does not retain active game audio
  void ssBgmPlayTitle(); // title theme resumes (this call comes from a click)
 ssShowView('ssHome');
}
function ssCreateWorld(){
 if(ssSaveReadIssue&&typeof ssSaveReadIssue.raw!=='string'){
  $('ssConfirmNote').textContent='브라우저가 이전 저장을 읽지 못했어요. 데이터 보호를 위해 새 월드로 덮어쓰지 않습니다.';return;
 }
 if(ssSaveReadIssue&&typeof ssSaveReadIssue.raw==='string'){
  if(!ssSaveReadIssue.backupAttempted){$('ssConfirmNote').textContent='기존 저장이 손상됐을 수 있어요. 먼저 「문제 있는 저장 원본 백업」을 눌러 다운로드하세요.';return;}
  if(!confirm('이전 저장은 읽을 수 없지만 백업을 요청했습니다. 다운로드 파일을 확인했나요? 정말 기존 저장을 새 월드로 대체할까요?'))return;
 }
 let probe=SAVE_KEY+':menu-storage-check';
 try{localStorage.setItem(probe,'1');localStorage.removeItem(probe)}catch(e){$('ssConfirmNote').textContent='브라우저 저장소에 쓸 수 없어 새 월드를 만들지 않았어요. 저장소 설정을 확인해 주세요.';return;}
 if(!resetKey()){$('ssConfirmNote').textContent='새 월드를 저장하지 못해 이전 진행 기록을 보존했어요.';return;}
 ssSaveReadIssue=null;ssSavedWorldAtBoot=true;ssEnterWorld();
}
function ssEscape(){if(!$('ssHome').hidden)return;ssShowView('ssHome')}
async function ssToggleFullscreen(){
 const msg=$('ssSettingsNote');
 try{
  if(document.fullscreenElement){await document.exitFullscreen();}
  else if(document.documentElement.requestFullscreen){await document.documentElement.requestFullscreen();}
  else{msg.textContent='이 브라우저에서는 전체 화면을 지원하지 않아요.';return;}
  msg.textContent=document.fullscreenElement?'전체 화면으로 전환했어요.':'전체 화면을 종료했어요.';
 }catch(e){msg.textContent='전체 화면 전환이 차단됐어요. 브라우저 설정을 확인해 주세요.';}
}
$('ssContinue').onclick=()=>{if(!ssSavedWorldAtBoot)return;ssEnterWorld();};
$('ssNew').onclick=()=>{$('ssConfirmNote').textContent='';ssUpdateSummary();ssShowView('ssConfirmView');};
$('ssSettings').onclick=()=>ssShowView('ssSettingsView');
for(const el of document.querySelectorAll('[data-ss-back]'))el.onclick=()=>ssShowView('ssHome');
$('ssConfirmCreate').onclick=ssCreateWorld;
$('ssBackup').onclick=()=>{if(ssSaveReadIssue)ssExportUnreadableSave();else if(ssSavedWorldAtBoot)exportGame();};
$('ssCargoBadge').onclick=ssCargoMenu;
$('ssConfirmBackup').onclick=()=>{if(ssSaveReadIssue)ssExportUnreadableSave();else if(ssSavedWorldAtBoot)exportGame();};
$('ssBgmToggle').onclick=()=>{ssBgmSetEnabled(!ssBgm.enabled);ssSyncSettings();};
$('ssBgmVolume').oninput=e=>ssBgmSetVolume(Number(e.target.value)/100);
$('ssSound').onclick=()=>{setSoundEnabled(!sfxState.enabled);ssSyncSettings();};
$('ssVolume').oninput=e=>{setSoundVolume(Number(e.target.value)/100);};
$('ssHaptics').onclick=()=>{ropeHapticsEnabled=!ropeHapticsEnabled;try{localStorage.setItem(ROPE_HAPTIC_KEY,ropeHapticsEnabled?'1':'0')}catch(_){}ssSyncSettings();if(ropeHapticsEnabled)ropeHaptic(8);};
$('ssRopeAB').onclick=()=>{setRopeABMode(ropeABMode==='A'?'B':'A');ssSyncSettings();};
$('ssFullscreen').onclick=ssToggleFullscreen;
$('ssFullscreenSettings').onclick=ssToggleFullscreen;

window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{hudReleaseMine();hudPadPointerId=null;hudPadDir=null;stick.classList.remove('pad-on');stopMineStick();input.left=input.right=input.act=input.jump=input.reelIn=input.reelOut=false;jumpBuffer=0;ropeReelPending=0;ropeHold=false;ropePointerAim=null;ropePreviewAnchor=null;ropeGestureFeedback();stopMineStick();if(!ssIsTitle())saveGame(true)});document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden){hudReleaseMine();hudPadPointerId=null;hudPadDir=null;stick.classList.remove('pad-on');stopMineStick();input.left=input.right=input.act=input.jump=input.reelIn=input.reelOut=false;jumpBuffer=0;ropeReelPending=0;ropeHold=false;ropePointerAim=null;ropePreviewAnchor=null;ropeGestureFeedback();stopMineStick();if(!ssIsTitle())saveGame(true)}});window.addEventListener('beforeunload',()=>{if(!ssIsTitle())saveGame(true)});

// M1.5 HUD router: town is an *UI scene* inside the existing mine region.
// No new village world ID or production save migration in this stage.
let ssM15Scene='mining',ssM15ManualMining=false,ssM15QuestExpanded=false;
function ssM15BaseScene(){
 if(ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID)return 'town';
 if(ssRegion==='mine')return 'mining';
 if(ssRegion==='life_forest_01')return 'forest';
 const depth=p.y-terrain(p.x);
 if(!Number.isFinite(depth))return 'town';
 // Hysteresis prevents flicker around the ground line while jumping.
 return depth>=(ssM15Scene==='mining'&&!ssM15ManualMining?1.4:3.0)?'mining':'town';
}
function ssM15ResetHeldInputs(){
 hudReleaseMine();hudReleasePadForScene();stopMineStick();
 holdTarget=null;holdLast=null;holdProgress=0;
 input.act=false;input.reelIn=false;input.reelOut=false;
 ropePointerAim=null;ropePreviewAnchor=null;ropeHold=false;ropeHoldTime=0;
 ropeGestureFeedback();
}
function hudReleasePadForScene(){
 // Clear stale finger ownership when a HUD layout changes, never keep a held key.
 if(hudPadPointerId!==null){try{stick.releasePointerCapture(hudPadPointerId)}catch(_){}}
 hudReleasePad();input.left=input.right=false;
}
function ssM15SyncScene(){
 if(!p||!game)return;
 const base=ssM15BaseScene();
 if(base==='mining'&&ssRegion==='mine')ssM15ManualMining=false;
 const next=ssM15ManualMining?'mining':base;
 if(next!==ssM15Scene){
  ssM15ResetHeldInputs();
  if(next!=='mining'&&rope.active)releaseRope();
  ssM15Scene=next;
 }
 const root=$('app');
 root.classList.toggle('ss-hud-town',next==='town');
 root.classList.toggle('ss-hud-forest',next==='forest');
 root.classList.toggle('ss-hud-mining',next==='mining');
 root.dataset.m15Manual=ssM15ManualMining?'1':'0';
 const b=$('m15ToolModeBtn');
 b.hidden=ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID||(next==='mining'&&!ssM15ManualMining);
 b.textContent=ssM15ManualMining?'↩ 생활 조작':'⛏ 채굴 모드';
 b.setAttribute('aria-label',ssM15ManualMining?'기본 생활 조작으로 돌아가기':'8방향 채굴과 로프 조작 켜기');
 $('m15MoveCaption').textContent=next==='mining'?'이동 · 로프 조준':'이동';
 $('controls').setAttribute('aria-label',next==='mining'?'이동, 8방향 채굴, 로프, 점프':'이동, 주변 상호작용, 점프');
}
function ssM15ToggleToolMode(){
 if(paused)return false;
 // Subterranean scene always uses the mining HUD; do not hide it underwater.
 if(ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID)return false;
 if(ssRegion==='mine'&&p.y-terrain(p.x)>=3)return false;
 ssM15ManualMining=!ssM15ManualMining;
 if(!ssM15ManualMining){releaseRope();ssM15ResetHeldInputs();}
 ssM15SyncScene();ssM1SyncHUD();return true;
}
$('m15ToolModeBtn').addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();ssM15ToggleToolMode();});
$('m1QuestBadge').addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();ssM15QuestExpanded=!ssM15QuestExpanded;$('app').classList.toggle('m15-quest-open',ssM15QuestExpanded);$('m1QuestBadge').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(ssM15QuestExpanded));$('m1QuestBadge').setAttribute('aria-label',ssM15QuestExpanded?'퀘스트 목표 접기':'퀘스트 목표 펼치기');});
function ssM15Near(worldX,maxDx,vertical=2.7){
 if(!p)return false;
 return Math.abs(p.x-worldX)<=maxDx && Math.abs(p.y-(terrain(worldX)-1))<=vertical;
}

// M1.6 PortalController: two spatial gates, explicit enter/tap/E, safe destination spawn.
// The village remains the *surface* of the existing mine world until migration is validated.
const SS_M16_PORTALS=Object.freeze({
 village:{id:'town-east-forest',region:TOWN_WORLD_ID,target:'life_forest_01',x:M1_MINE_GATE_X,label:'잔빛숲으로 들어가기',arrival:'잔빛숲',spawnX:M1_FOREST_GATE_X+5},
 forest:{id:'forest-west-town',region:'life_forest_01',target:TOWN_WORLD_ID,x:M1_FOREST_GATE_X,label:'도래마을로 돌아가기',arrival:'도래마을',spawnX:M1_MINE_GATE_X-5},
 townMine:{id:'town-west-mine',region:TOWN_WORLD_ID,target:'mine',x:TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X,label:'광산으로 내려가기',arrival:'광산',spawnX:TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X+4},
 mine:{id:'mine-surface-town',region:'mine',target:TOWN_WORLD_ID,x:TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X,label:'도래마을로 돌아가기',arrival:'도래마을',spawnX:TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X-4}
});
function ssM22PortalsInWorld(){return Object.values(SS_M16_PORTALS).filter(g=>g.region===ssRegion);}
let ssM16TransitionLocked=false,ssM16LastTravelAt=-10000,ssM16TravelCount=0,ssM16LastResult='idle';
function ssM16CurrentGate(){return ssM22PortalsInWorld().sort((a,b)=>Math.abs((p?.x||0)-a.x)-Math.abs((p?.x||0)-b.x))[0]||SS_M16_PORTALS.mine;}
function ssM16NearPortal(gate=ssM16CurrentGate()){
 if(!p||!game||paused||ssM16TransitionLocked||ssRegion!==gate.region)return false;
 // Mine portal remains accessible to older saves on the original surface.
 return Math.abs(p.x-gate.x)<=2.9 && Math.abs(p.y-(terrain(gate.x)-1))<=2.6;
}
function ssM16PortalFootprintHit(q,gate=ssM16CurrentGate()){
 // x/y are world tile coordinates from pointerTile, not screen pixels.
 const floor=terrain(gate.x)-1;
 return Math.abs(q.x+.5-gate.x)<=1.9 && q.y>=floor-3.5 && q.y<=floor+0.65;
}
function ssM16TryPortalTap(q){
 const gate=ssM22PortalsInWorld().find(g=>ssM16PortalFootprintHit(q,g));
 if(!gate)return false;
 if(!ssM16NearPortal(gate)){flash('출입구 가까이 다가가서 이용해 주세요');return true;}
 ssM16RequestTravel(gate.target,gate.id);return true;
}
function ssM16DrawPortalPrompt(){
 if(!p||!game||ssM16TransitionLocked)return;
 ctx.save();ctx.font='bold 11px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeStyle='#183344';
 for(const gate of ssM22PortalsInWorld()){
  const sx=Math.round(gate.x*T-camera.x),sy=Math.round((terrain(gate.x)-1)*T-camera.y);
  if(sx<-90||sx>viewW+90)continue;
  const near=ssM16NearPortal(gate);
  ctx.fillStyle=gate.target==='mine'?'#7d6b57':'#705945';ctx.fillRect(sx-16,sy-78,8,80);ctx.fillRect(sx+30,sy-78,8,80);ctx.fillRect(sx-16,sy-78,54,10);
  if(near){ctx.globalAlpha=.28+.10*Math.sin(frame*.1);ctx.fillStyle='#b8fbe5';ctx.fillRect(sx-26,sy-75,70,75);ctx.globalAlpha=1;}
  const name=near?'E · '+gate.label:gate.target==='mine'?'↓ 광산':gate.target===TOWN_WORLD_ID?'← 도래마을':'→ 잔빛숲';
  ctx.strokeText(name,sx+7,sy-92);ctx.fillStyle=near?'#fff3be':'#e6f7d1';ctx.fillText(name,sx+7,sy-92);
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
function ssM16ResolveSafeSpawn(target,sourceGateId=''){
 let start=target==='mine'?TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X+4:target==='life_forest_01'?M1_FOREST_GATE_X+5:sourceGateId==='mine-surface-town'?TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X-4:M1_MINE_GATE_X-5;
 const offsets=[0,.5,-.5,1,-1,1.5,-1.5,2,-2,2.5,-2.5];
 for(const off of offsets){const x=start+off,y=terrain(x)-1;
  if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<=17||x>=79)continue;
  if(!collides(x,y))return {x,y};
 }
 return null;
}
// M2.5-A: presentation only. Real asynchronous world readiness belongs to M2.5-C/C.
const M25A_WORLD_META=Object.freeze({
 village_hub_01:{name:'도래마을',subtitle:'생활과 거래가 모이는 곳',index:'01',first:'마을에서 새로운 하루를 시작해요',repeat:'도래마을에 돌아왔어요'},
 mine:{name:'광산',subtitle:'땅속에 잠든 별의 흔적',index:'02',first:'지층 아래를 탐험해 보세요',repeat:'깊이를 다시 확인하세요'},
 life_forest_01:{name:'잔빛숲',subtitle:'바람과 물길을 따라',index:'03',first:'숲길에 발을 들였어요',repeat:'숲의 시간이 흐르고 있어요'},
 farm_01:{name:'도래 농장',subtitle:'작은 씨앗에서 시작되는 하루',index:'04',first:'씨앗을 심을 준비를 하세요',repeat:'작물이 어떻게 자랐을까요?'},
 ruins_3d_01:{name:'별맥 고대 유적',subtitle:'잊힌 시대의 기억을 찾아서',index:'05',first:'고대 유적을 조사할 수 있어요',repeat:'유적의 길이 다시 열립니다'}
});
const m25aVisited=new Set();let m25aLastWorld=null,m25aPreview=false;
function m25aRenderWorld(worldId,preview=false){
 const meta=M25A_WORLD_META[worldId];if(!meta)return false;
 const cover=$('m16TransitionCover');
 cover.dataset.world=worldId;cover.setAttribute('aria-label',meta.name+' 이동 중');
 $('m25WorldIndex').textContent='WORLD '+meta.index+' / 05';
 $('m16TransitionTitle').textContent=meta.name;$('m25WorldTagline').textContent=meta.subtitle;
 $('m25WorldTip').textContent=(m25aVisited.has(worldId)?meta.repeat:meta.first);
 $('m16TransitionSubtitle').textContent=preview?'화면 디자인 확인 중':'월드 진입 지점을 확인하는 중…';
 m25aLastWorld=worldId;m25aPreview=preview;
 if(!preview)m25aVisited.add(worldId);
 return true;
}

// M2.5-C: unified all-world rollback, captured BEFORE changing region or portal coordinates.
function m25bSnapshot(){
 let persisted=null;
 try{persisted=localStorage.getItem(SAVE_KEY);}catch(_){}
 const copy=v=>v===undefined?undefined:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
 return {persisted,region:ssRegion,story:copy(game.storyM1),town:copy(game.town25dV1),
  playerX:game.playerX,playerY:game.playerY,camera:{x:camera.x,y:camera.y},
  farm:copy(game.farmWorldV1),arch:copy(game.archWorldV1),
  p:{x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:p.vx,vy:p.vy,grounded:p.grounded},
  farmActive:farmWorldActive,archActive:archWorldActive,townActive:town25dActive,
  farmPosition:{...farmPlayer},archPosition:{...archPlayer},archYaw,

function m25bRestore(snapshot){
 // Restore the source world before touching renderers. Never clear the original save key.
 ssRegion=snapshot.region;
 if(snapshot.story===undefined)delete game.storyM1;else game.storyM1=snapshot.story;
 if(snapshot.town===undefined)delete game.town25dV1;else game.town25dV1=snapshot.town;
 if(snapshot.farm===undefined)delete game.farmWorldV1;else game.farmWorldV1=snapshot.farm;
 if(snapshot.arch===undefined)delete game.archWorldV1;else game.archWorldV1=snapshot.arch;
 game.playerX=snapshot.playerX;game.playerY=snapshot.playerY;
 Object.assign(p,snapshot.p);Object.assign(farmPlayer,snapshot.farmPosition);
 Object.assign(archPlayer,snapshot.archPosition);archYaw=snapshot.archYaw;
 Object.assign(town25dPlayer,snapshot.townPosition);t25Camera={...snapshot.townCamera};
 t25LastRegion=snapshot.townLastRegion;camera.x=snapshot.camera.x;camera.y=snapshot.camera.y;
 ssM15ManualMining=snapshot.manualMining;ssM15Scene=snapshot.scene;
 if(snapshot.farmActive){if(!farmWorldActive)farmWorldActivate();else farmWorldDraw();}
 else if(farmWorldActive)farmWorldDeactivate();
 if(snapshot.archActive){if(!archWorldActive)archWorldActivate();else archWorldDraw();}
 else if(archWorldActive)archWorldDeactivate();

  if(!town25dActive)t25Activate();

  t25Draw(t25Ent);
 }else if(town25dActive)t25Deactivate();
 try{if(snapshot.persisted===null)localStorage.removeItem(SAVE_KEY);
     else localStorage.setItem(SAVE_KEY,snapshot.persisted);}catch(e){console.warn('m25c rollback persistence blocked',e);}

function m25bReady(worldId){
 if(worldId===TOWN_WORLD_ID){
  // Do not confuse a placeholder town drawing with completed async WorldForge mount.
  if(ssRegion!==TOWN_WORLD_ID||!town25dActive||t25Root.hidden)return false;
  const state=town25dEngine?.state;
  if(!['ready','paused','running','stopped'].includes(state)||town25dEngine.worldId!==T25_ID)return false;
  t25Resize();t25Draw(t25Ent);
  return t25Canvas.width>1&&t25Canvas.height>1&&t25W>1&&t25H>1
    &&!!t25Ctx&&t25Ctx.getImageData(Math.floor(t25Canvas.width/2),Math.floor(t25Canvas.height/2),1,1).data[3]>0;
 }
 if(worldId==='mine'||worldId==='life_forest_01'){
  if(ssRegion!==worldId||farmWorldActive||archWorldActive||town25dActive)return false;
  resize();draw();
  return cv.width>1&&cv.height>1&&viewW>1&&viewH>1;
 }
 if(worldId==='farm_01'){
  if(!farmWorldActive||farmRoot.hidden)return false;
  farmWorldResize();farmWorldDraw();
  return farmCanvas.width>1&&farmCanvas.height>1&&farmCanvasW>1&&farmCanvasH>1;
 }
 if(worldId==='ruins_3d_01'){
  if(!archWorldActive||archRoot.hidden)return false;
  if(archRenderer!=='cpu'&&archRenderer!=='webgl')return false;
  archWorldResize();archWorldDraw();
  const canvas=archRenderer==='webgl'?archGpuCanvas:archFallbackCanvas;
  return !canvas.hidden&&canvas.width>1&&canvas.height>1&&!!(archRenderer==='webgl'?archGl:archCpuCtx);
 }
 return false;
}
async function m25bWaitReady(destination){
 const started=performance.now();let lastError=null;
 while(performance.now()-started<M25B_READY_TIMEOUT_MS){
  await m25bFrame();
  try{if(m25bReady(destination))return true;}catch(e){lastError=e;}
  if(destination===TOWN_WORLD_ID&&town25dEngine?.state==='failed')break;
 }
 if(lastError)console.warn('M2.5-C destination readiness',lastError);
 return false;
}
async function m25bTransition(destination,action,core,source){
 if(m25bBusy||ssM16TransitionLocked||ssIsTitle()||paused)return false;
 const snapshot=m25bSnapshot(), priorPaused=paused,started=performance.now();
 m25bBusy=true;ssM16TransitionLocked=true;m25bDestination=destination;
 m25bLastResult='pending';m25bPhase='cover';paused=true;
 m25bClearInputs();m25aRenderWorld(destination,false);m25aSetVisible(true);
 m25bSetStatus('입력을 정리하고 월드를 준비하는 중…');
 let ok=false,error=null,coreFinished=false;
 try{
  await m25bFrame(); // show actual cover before changing the destination renderer
  m25bPhase='prepare';m25bSetStatus('월드 데이터와 출입구를 확인하는 중…');
  const changed=await core();if(changed!==true)throw new Error('saved transition rejected');
  coreFinished=true;m25bPhase='render';m25bSetStatus('첫 화면을 렌더링하는 중…');
  await m25bFrame();
  ok=await m25bWaitReady(destination);
  if(!ok)throw new Error('destination first frame not ready');
  if(action.startsWith('portal:')&&!saveGame(true))throw new Error('portal atomic commit rejected');
  m25bPhase='ready';m25bSetStatus('준비 완료 · 월드로 들어갑니다');
  await m25bDelay(Math.max(0,M25B_MIN_SHOW_MS-(performance.now()-started)));
  m25bCompleted++;m25bLastResult='success';
   // Change BGM only after world readiness and atomic portal save succeed.
   void ssBgmSwitchRegion(destination);
 }catch(e){
  error=e;ok=false;m25bLastResult='failed';m25bPhase='rollback';
  console.warn('M2.5-C transition rollback',action,e);
  // If persistence changed, roll it back before exposing the source world.
  try{m25bRestore(snapshot);}catch(restoreErr){console.error('M2.5-C rollback',restoreErr);}
  m25bSetStatus('이동이 취소됐어요 · 이전 월드로 돌아갑니다');
  await m25bDelay(Math.max(280,M25B_MIN_SHOW_MS-(performance.now()-started)));
 }finally{
  m25aSetVisible(false);paused=priorPaused;
  m25bClearInputs();m25bBusy=false;ssM16TransitionLocked=false;m25bPhase='idle';m25bDestination='';last=performance.now();
 }
 if(!ok){
  if(source==='farm_01'&&farmWorldActive)farmWorldToast('출입구 확인·저장 또는 렌더링 준비에 실패했어요');
  else if(source==='ruins_3d_01'&&archWorldActive)archWorldNotify('월드 이동이 취소됐어요');
  else flash('월드 이동이 취소됐어요. 이전 지역을 유지합니다');
 }
 return ok;
}
window.__sandstarWorldLoadingM25B=Object.freeze({

   farmActive:farmWorldActive,archActive:archWorldActive,displayed:$('m16TransitionCover').classList.contains('active')}),
 ready:worldId=>worldId==='farm_01'&&farmWorldActive?farmCanvas.width>1&&farmCanvas.height>1:
  worldId==='ruins_3d_01'&&archWorldActive?(archRenderer==='webgl'?!!archGl:!!archCpuCtx):
  ['mine','life_forest_01'].includes(worldId)&&!farmWorldActive&&!archWorldActive&&!town25dActive&&ssRegion===worldId||worldId===TOWN_WORLD_ID&&town25dActive&&['ready','paused','running','stopped'].includes(town25dEngine?.state)&&town25dEngine?.worldId===T25_ID,
 worlds:['village_hub_01','mine','life_forest_01','farm_01','ruins_3d_01']
});
// M2.5-C: the same full-screen readiness/rollback used by farm + ruins now
// handles town, mine and forest. Town adapter is authenticated by a nearby 2.5D gate.
async function ssM16RequestTravel(target,requestedGateId=null,options={}){
 const gate=ssM22PortalsInWorld().find(g=>g.target===target&&(!requestedGateId||g.id===requestedGateId))||ssM16CurrentGate();
 const fromTown=options?.fromTown===true;
 const townTarget=fromTown&&town25dActive&&ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID
    ?T25_TARGETS.find(t=>t.target===target&&t25Distance(t)<=2.65):null;
 if(ssM16TransitionLocked||ssIsTitle()||paused||target!==gate.target
    ||(fromTown?!townTarget:!ssM16NearPortal(gate)))return false;
 if(performance.now()-ssM16LastTravelAt<1000){flash('출입구를 다시 이용하려면 잠시 기다려 주세요');return false;}
 ssM16LastResult='pending';
 const source=ssRegion;
 const result=await m25bTransition(target,'portal:'+gate.id,()=>{
  // Only after m25bSnapshot() has captured the actual 2.5D location.
  if(fromTown){
   if(game?.town25dV1)game.town25dV1.position={...town25dPlayer};
   p.x=gate.x;p.y=terrain(gate.x)-1;p.vx=0;p.vy=0;
  }
  paused=false;
  try{return ssM1Transition(target,true,gate.id,true);}finally{paused=true;}
 },source);
 ssM16LastResult=result?'success':'failed';
 if(result){ssM16TravelCount++;ssM16LastTravelAt=performance.now();}
 return result;
}

window.__sandstarWorldLoadingM25C=Object.freeze({state:()=>({

// M1.7 — real forest objects resolve touch/E action at the actual location.
// All payouts, inventory changes, timers and duplicate checks are delegated to the proven P1.1 command engine.
const SS_M17_OBJECTS=Object.freeze([
 ...LIVING_SITES.plots.map(x=>Object.freeze({id:'plot:'+x,type:'plot',x})),
 {id:'pond',type:'pond',x:LIVING_SITES.pond},
 ...LIVING_SITES.trees.map(x=>Object.freeze({id:'tree:'+x,type:'tree',x}))
]);
let ssM17PanelKind=null,ssM17PanelTarget=null,ssM17Selected=null,ssM17LastAction='',ssM17PanelFocus=null;
function ssM17NearObject(o,range=3.15){
 if(!game||!p||ssRegion!=='life_forest_01'||ssM15Scene==='mining'||ssM16TransitionLocked)return false;
 const dy=p.y-(terrain(o.x)-1),dx=p.x-o.x;
 return Math.abs(dx)<=range && Math.abs(dy)<=2.75 && Math.hypot(dx,dy*1.3)<=range+0.7;
}
function ssM17NearbyObject(){
 if(!p||!game||paused||ssRegion!=='life_forest_01'||ssM15Scene==='mining')return null;
 const choices=SS_M17_OBJECTS.filter(o=>ssM17NearObject(o)).map(o=>({o,d:Math.hypot(p.x-o.x,(p.y-(terrain(o.x)-1))*1.3)})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d);
 if(!choices.length)return null;
 const selected=choices.find(c=>c.o.id===ssM17Selected);
 return selected&&selected.d<=choices[0].d+0.65?selected.o:choices[0].o;
}
function ssM17ObjectById(id){return SS_M17_OBJECTS.find(o=>o.id===id)||null;}
function ssM17ActionLabel(o){
 const w=game?.livingP0;if(!o||!w)return '주변 행동';
 if(o.type==='tree'){const waiting=w.trees[o.id]-w.clock;return waiting>0?(w.bag.sapling>0?'🌱 묘목 심기':'🌲 나무 재생 중'):'🪓 나무 벌목';}
 if(o.type==='plot'){
  const plot=w.plots[o.id];if(!plot||plot.plantedAt===null)return '🌾 씨앗 심기';
  if(!plot.watered)return '💧 밭에 물 주기';
  const sec=plot.crop==='legacy'?90:LIVING_CROPS[plot.crop]?.seconds||90;
  return w.clock-plot.plantedAt>=sec?'🌾 작물 수확':'🌱 작물 성장 확인';
 }

}
function ssM17DoAction(id){
 const o=ssM17ObjectById(id);if(!o||!ssM17NearObject(o)||paused){flash('대상 가까이 다가가서 이용해 주세요');return false;}
 ssM17Selected=o.id;
 if(o.type==='tree'){
  const w=game.livingP0,waiting=w.trees[id]-w.clock;
  const type=waiting<=0?'tree.cut':'tree.plant';
  const r=livingAction(type,id);ssM17LastAction=type;
  if(r.ok)updHud();return !!r.ok;
 }
 if(o.type==='plot'){
  const w=game.livingP0,plot=w.plots[id];
  if(plot.plantedAt===null){ssM17OpenPanel('seeds',id);return true;}
  const type=plot.watered?'plot.harvest':'plot.water';
  const r=livingAction(type,id);ssM17LastAction=type;
  if(r.ok)updHud();return !!r.ok;
 }
 if(o.type==='pond'){ssM17OpenPanel('fish','pond');return true;}
 return false;
}
function ssM17TryObjectTap(q){
 if(ssRegion!=='life_forest_01'||ssM15Scene==='mining'||paused||ssM16TransitionLocked)return false;
 const candidates=SS_M17_OBJECTS.filter(o=>Math.abs(q.x+.5-o.x)<=(o.type==='tree'?1.8:1.55)&&q.y>=(terrain(o.x)-1)-(o.type==='tree'?3.75:2.25)&&q.y<=(terrain(o.x)-1)+1.3)
  .map(o=>({o,d:Math.abs(q.x+.5-o.x)})).sort((a,b)=>a.d-b.d);
 if(!candidates.length)return false;
 const obj=candidates[0].o;
 if(!ssM17NearObject(obj)){flash('나무·밭·낚시터에 조금 더 가까이 가세요');return true;}
 ssM17DoAction(obj.id);return true;
}
function ssM17DrawObjectMarker(){

 const x=o.x*T-camera.x,foot=(terrain(o.x)-1)*T-camera.y;
 if(x<-90||x>viewW+90)return;
 const t=1+.055*Math.sin(frame*.13);
 ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle='#f8e9aa';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.setLineDash([4,3]);ctx.strokeRect(x-23*t,foot-(o.type==='tree'?76:36),53*t,o.type==='tree'?80:42);ctx.setLineDash([]);
 ctx.fillStyle='#193e42eb';ctx.fillRect(x-30,foot-(o.type==='tree'?102:59),66,20);
 ctx.fillStyle='#fff0bb';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.font='bold 11px system-ui';ctx.fillText('E · '+(o.type==='tree'?'벌목':o.type==='plot'?'농사':'낚시'),x+3,foot-(o.type==='tree'?87:44));ctx.restore();
}

 }else{

  const actions=!w.rod?'<button data-m17="craft" type="button" '+((game.inv.wood||0)<3?'disabled':'')+'>🪵 낚싯대 만들기 (원목 3)</button>':f?'<button data-m17="reel" type="button">⬆ 줄 감기</button><button data-m17="slacken" type="button">⬇ 줄 풀기</button>':'<button data-m17="cast" type="button" '+(w.clock<w.pondReadyAt?'disabled':'')+'>🎣 낚싯대 던지기</button>';
  pane.innerHTML='<h2>🎣 잔빛숲 강변 낚시</h2>'+state+'<div class="m17-actions">'+actions+'</div><button class="m17-exit" data-m17="close" type="button">낚시 화면 닫기</button><p class="m17-info">'+(message||('도감 '+w.fishDex.length+'/3종 · 포획 '+w.stats.fished+'마리'))+'</p>';

// M1 story slice: organic quest, no compulsory dialogue locks or new paid resources.
function ssM1NearbyAction(){
 if(!p||!game||paused)return null;
 const x=p.x;
   if(ssRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID){
   if(ssM16NearPortal(SS_M16_PORTALS.townMine))return {label:'⛏ 광산으로 내려가기',act:'mine-enter'};

   {
    const cands=[

     {x:59,r:2,label:'🪚 목수 하린와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-harin'},
    {x:18,r:2,label:'💰 상인 마루와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-maru'},
    {x:31,r:2,label:'⛏️ 광부 갱이와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-gaengi'},
    {x:35,r:2,label:'🌱 농부 솔아와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-sola'},
    {x:44,r:2,label:'🔬 연구자 서온와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-seoon'},
    {x:47,r:2,label:'🛗 승강장지기 노을와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-noeul'},
    {x:51,r:2,label:'🔨 장인 토박와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-tobak'},
    {x:70,r:2,label:'🎣 어부 여울와 대화 (임시 NPC)',act:'npc-yeoul'}
    ];
    let best=null,bd=1e9;
    for(const c of cands){if(ssM15Near(c.x,c.r)){const d=Math.abs(p.x-c.x);if(d<bd){bd=d;best=c;}}}
    if(best)return best;
   }
  }else if(ssRegion==='mine'){
   if(ssM16NearPortal(SS_M16_PORTALS.mine))return {label:'🏘️ 도래마을로 올라가기',act:'mine-exit'};
   if(ssM15Near(M1_MINE_CRYSTAL_X,3.1)&&!game.storyM1.crystalSeen)return {label:'✦ 빛나는 광맥 조사',act:'crystal'};
  }else{
  if(archWorldNearForestGate())return {label:'✦ 3D 유적 들어가기',act:'arch-enter'};
  if(ssM16NearPortal(SS_M16_PORTALS.forest))return {label:'🏘️ 도래마을 돌아가기',act:'exit'};
  if(ssM15Near(M1_FOREST_SPRING_X,3.8))return {label:game.storyM1.springRepaired?'💧 별샘의 기록 보기':'✦ 꺼진 별샘 조사·복구',act:'spring'};
  if(ssM15Near(113,2.5))return {label:'📖 연구자 서온과 대화',act:'seon'};
  const livingObject=ssM17NearbyObject();if(livingObject)return {label:ssM17ActionLabel(livingObject),act:'m17-object',targetId:livingObject.id};
 }
 return null;
}
function ssM1QuestText(){
 const st=game?.storyM1;if(!st)return '월드 데이터를 확인하는 중';
 if(st.springRepaired)return '물길이 돌아왔다 · 자유 탐험과 주민 의뢰를 이어가세요.';
 if(!st.crystalSeen)return '마을 광산 입구 X40으로 내려가 X55의 빛나는 광맥을 조사하세요.';
 if(!st.forestVisited)return '마을 동쪽 X64 출입구에서 잔빛숲으로 이동하세요.';
 if(ssRegion==='mine')return '광산 출입구 X40 → 마을 → 잔빛숲의 별샘을 찾아가세요.';
 return '별샘 X120 · 재료: 원목 2, 돌 2 · 채굴·벌목으로 준비.';
}
function ssM1SyncHUD(){
 const badge=$('m1QuestBadge'),label=$('m1QuestText'),b=$('m1ActionBtn');if(!badge||!b||!game||!p)return;
 label.textContent=ssM1QuestText();farmWorldSyncForestGate();
 const item=ssM16TransitionLocked?null:ssM1NearbyAction();b.hidden=!item;
 if(item){b.textContent=item.label;b.dataset.action=item.act;}
}
function ssM1LogEvent(id){const a=game.storyM1.storyEvents;if(!a.includes(id)){a.push(id);if(a.length>24)a.shift();}}
function ssM1Transition(target,fromPortal=false,sourceGateId='',deferSave=false){
 if(!game||!p||paused||!['mine','life_forest_01',TOWN_WORLD_ID].includes(target)||target===ssRegion)return false;
 const previousRegion=ssRegion,prevWorld={x:game.playerX,y:game.playerY},prevPos={x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:p.vx,vy:p.vy},prevStory=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(game.storyM1));
 if(!deferSave&&!saveGame(true)){flash('이동 전 저장이 차단됐어요. 기존 위치를 유지합니다.');return false;}
 if(previousRegion==='mine')game.storyM1.minePos={x:p.x,y:p.y};else if(previousRegion===TOWN_WORLD_ID)game.storyM1.townPos={x:p.x,y:p.y};else game.storyM1.forestPos={x:p.x,y:p.y};
 game.storyM1.region=target;ssRegion=target;
 const dest=target==='mine'?game.storyM1.minePos:target===TOWN_WORLD_ID?game.storyM1.townPos:game.storyM1.forestPos;
 const safe=fromPortal?ssM16ResolveSafeSpawn(target,sourceGateId):null;
 const targetX=fromPortal?(safe?.x??NaN):(dest?.x||(target==='mine'?TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X+.5:target===TOWN_WORLD_ID?SPAWN_X+.5:M1_FOREST_GATE_X+2));
 const targetY=fromPortal?(safe?.y??NaN):(dest?.y||terrain(targetX)-1);
 releaseRope();hudReleaseMine();stopMineStick();holdTarget=null;holdLast=null;holdProgress=0;
 input.left=input.right=input.jump=input.reelIn=input.reelOut=false;
 p.x=targetX;p.y=targetY;p.vx=0;p.vy=0;p.grounded=false;
 if(!fromPortal&&collides(p.x,p.y)){p.x=(target==='mine'?TOWN_MINE_PORTAL_X+2:target===TOWN_WORLD_ID?SPAWN_X+1:M1_FOREST_GATE_X+2)+.5;p.y=terrain(p.x)-1;}
 if(collides(p.x,p.y)||!Number.isFinite(p.x)||!Number.isFinite(p.y)){
  game.storyM1=prevStory;ssRegion=previousRegion;p.x=prevPos.x;p.y=prevPos.y;p.vx=prevPos.vx;p.vy=prevPos.vy;flash('안전한 진입 위치를 찾지 못했어요.');return false;
 }
 if(target==='life_forest_01'){game.storyM1.forestVisited=true;ssM1LogEvent('entered-forest');}
 game.playerX=p.x;game.playerY=p.y;
 if(!deferSave&&!saveGame(true)){
  game.storyM1=prevStory;ssRegion=previousRegion;game.playerX=prevWorld.x;game.playerY=prevWorld.y;
  p.x=prevPos.x;p.y=prevPos.y;p.vx=prevPos.vx;p.vy=prevPos.vy;
  flash('저장 실패로 지역 이동을 취소했어요.');return false;
 }
 camera.x=Math.max(0,p.x*T-viewW*.45);camera.y=Math.max(0,p.y*T-viewH*.5);
 ssM15ManualMining=false;ssM15Scene='';ssM15ResetHeldInputs();
 visionCache.cx=-999;updateVisionCache(true);updHud();flash(target==='mine'?'광산에 도착했어요':target===TOWN_WORLD_ID?'도래마을에 도착했어요':'새 지역 발견 · 잔빛숲');return true;
}
function ssM1InspectCrystal(){
 if(ssRegion!=='mine'||Math.abs(p.x-M1_MINE_CRYSTAL_X)>3.1)return false;
 if(game.storyM1.crystalSeen){flash('이미 기록한 별맥의 흔적이에요');return true;}
 if(game.mined<1){flash('주변 흙이나 돌을 먼저 한 번 채굴해 보세요.');return false;}
 game.storyM1.crystalSeen=true;ssM1LogEvent('crystal-discovered');
 if(!saveGame(true)){game.storyM1.crystalSeen=false;game.storyM1.storyEvents=game.storyM1.storyEvents.filter(x=>x!=='crystal-discovered');flash('저장할 수 없어 발견을 기록하지 못했어요');return false;}
 updHud();flash('✦ 별맥의 흔적 발견! 동쪽 X64 숲길로 향하세요.');return true;
}
function ssM1SpringMenu(){
 if(ssRegion!=='life_forest_01'||Math.abs(p.x-M1_FOREST_SPRING_X)>3.8)return false;
 const st=game.storyM1;
 if(st.springRepaired){showModal('💧 다시 흐르는 별샘','<p>작은 물줄기가 돌아왔습니다. 그러나 오래된 장치에는 경고가 새겨져 있어요.</p><p><em>“흐름을 되찾는 자여, 무엇이 잠들어 있는지도 기억하라.”</em></p><p class="note">제1장 완료 · 이후의 이야기는 후속 개발에서 이어집니다. 생활·채굴은 계속할 수 있습니다.</p>');return true;}
 showModal('✦ 꺼진 샘의 비밀',`<p>메마른 강의 상류에 봉인된 별맥 장치가 있습니다. 낡은 수리판에는 <strong>원목 2개와 돌 2개</strong>가 필요하다고 적혀 있어요.</p><div class="line"><div>✦ 광맥 조사 기록</div><strong>${st.crystalSeen?'발견함':'미발견 · 마을 X55'}</strong></div><div class="line"><div>원목</div><strong>${game.inv.wood||0} / 2</strong></div><div class="line"><div>돌</div><strong>${game.inv.stone||0} / 2</strong></div><div class="stack"><button type="button" class="cta" id="m1RepairBtn" ${st.crystalSeen&&game.inv.wood>=2&&game.inv.stone>=2?'':'disabled'}>별샘 수리하기</button></div><p class="note">숲 나무 X82·94·106에서 벌목하고, 마을 광산에서 돌을 채굴하세요. 지역을 오가도 소지품은 보존됩니다.</p>`);
 $('m1RepairBtn').onclick=ssM1RepairSpring;return true;
}
function ssM1RepairSpring(){
 const st=game.storyM1;
 if(ssRegion!=='life_forest_01'||Math.abs(p.x-M1_FOREST_SPRING_X)>3.8||st.springRepaired||!st.crystalSeen||game.inv.wood<2||game.inv.stone<2){flash('별맥 조사와 수리 재료가 더 필요해요.');return false;}
 const prev={wood:game.inv.wood,stone:game.inv.stone,story:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(st))};
 game.inv.wood-=2;game.inv.stone-=2;st.springRepaired=true;st.storyRewarded=true;ssM1LogEvent('spring-repaired');
 if(!saveGame(true)){game.inv.wood=prev.wood;game.inv.stone=prev.stone;game.storyM1=prev.story;flash('저장할 수 없어 수리를 취소했어요. 재료는 보존됐습니다.');return false;}
 closeModal();updHud();flash('💧 첫 번째 별맥이 깨어났어요!');return true;
}
function ssM1Talk(role){
 if(role==='harin'){
  showModal('🪚 하린 · 도래마을의 목수',`<p>“여긴 고칠 게 많아. 그래도 돌아올 길은 남겨 두었어.”</p><p>${game.storyM1.crystalSeen?'별빛 결정이라… 그럼 숲의 오래된 수로 장치도 다시 움직일지 몰라.':'저쪽 X55에서 묘한 빛이 보여. 근처 땅을 조금 캐보고 살펴줄래?'}</p><p class="note">마을 동쪽 X64의 나무문을 지나면 잔빛숲으로 이어집니다. 생활권은 별도의 맵이지만 자원과 장비는 공유합니다.</p>`);return true;
 }
 if(role==='seon'){
  showModal('📖 서온 · 지질 조사원',`<p>“빛이 난다는 사실과 안전하다는 결론은 다르죠. 지금은 둘을 구분해야 해요.”</p><p>${game.storyM1.springRepaired?'물길은 돌아왔지만, 봉인된 장치가 왜 있었는지는 더 조사해야 합니다.':'이 길 끝 X120의 샘에 고대 결정 회로가 있어요. 광산의 별광 흔적을 기록하고 원목 2개와 돌 2개로 장치를 수리해 볼 수 있을 거예요.'}</p><p class="note">서온은 이 세계의 별맥이 자연의 순환인지, 누군가가 설계한 장치인지 아직 판단하지 않았습니다.</p>`);return true;
 }
 return false;
}

function ssNpcLoadState(){try{const s=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(SS_NPC_SAVE_KEY)||'{}');return s&&typeof s==='object'?s:{};}catch(e){return {};}}
let ssNpcState=ssNpcLoadState();
function ssNpcSaveState(){try{localStorage.setItem(SS_NPC_SAVE_KEY,JSON.stringify(ssNpcState));}catch(e){}}
let ssNpcAudio=null;
function ssNpcStopVoice(){try{if(ssNpcAudio){ssNpcAudio.pause();ssNpcAudio=null;}}catch(e){}}
function ssNpcPlayVoice(id,lineNo){
 ssNpcStopVoice();
 if(!sfxState||!sfxState.enabled)return;
 try{
  const a=new Audio(SS_NPC_VOICE_BASE+'/'+id+'-'+String(lineNo).padStart(2,'0')+'.mp3');
  a.preload='auto';
  a.addEventListener('error',()=>{if(ssNpcAudio===a)ssNpcAudio=null;});
  ssNpcAudio=a;
  const pr=a.play();if(pr&&pr.catch)pr.catch(()=>{if(ssNpcAudio===a)ssNpcAudio=null;});
 }catch(e){ssNpcAudio=null;}
}
function ssNpcById(id){return SS_NPC_DATA.find(n=>n.id===id)||null;}
function ssNpcFlat(npc){return [...npc.first,...npc.idle,npc.hint];}
function ssNpcTalk(id){
 const npc=ssNpcById(id);if(!npc)return;
 const st=ssNpcState;st.met=st.met||{};st.idle=st.idle||{};
 const met=!!st.met[id];
 let mode=met?'idle':'first',idx=0;
 if(mode==='idle'){idx=(st.idle[id]||0)%npc.idle.length;}
 const lineNo=()=>mode==='first'?idx+1:mode==='idle'?idx+4:10;
 const lineText=()=>mode==='first'?npc.first[idx]:mode==='idle'?npc.idle[idx]:npc.hint;
 const prog=()=>mode==='first'?('첫 만남 '+(idx+1)+'/3'):mode==='idle'?('평소 '+(idx+1)+'/3'):'힌트';
 const showLine=()=>{
  const el=$('ssNpcLine');if(el)el.textContent='“'+lineText()+'”';
  const pr=$('ssNpcProg');if(pr)pr.textContent=prog()+(met?'':' · 처음 만났어요');
  ssNpcPlayVoice(id,lineNo());
 };
 const storyBtn=npc.story?`<button class="ghost" id="ssNpcStoryBtn" type="button">📖 제1장 이야기 보기</button>`:'';
 showModal(npc.emoji+' '+npc.name+' · '+npc.role,`<p class="ss-npc-temp">임시 NPC — 정식 확정 전 대화 미리보기입니다.</p><p id="ssNpcLine" class="ss-npc-line"></p><p id="ssNpcProg" class="ss-npc-prog"></p><div class="stack"><button class="cta" id="ssNpcNextBtn" type="button">다음 ▶</button><button class="ghost" id="ssNpcHintBtn" type="button">힌트 듣기</button>${storyBtn}</div>`);
 $('backBtn').onclick=()=>{ssNpcStopVoice();closeModal();};
 $('ssNpcNextBtn').onclick=()=>{
  if(mode==='first'){idx++;if(idx>=npc.first.length){mode='idle';idx=0;st.met[id]=true;ssNpcSaveState();}}
  else if(mode==='hint'){mode='idle';idx=(st.idle[id]||0)%npc.idle.length;}
  else{idx=(idx+1)%npc.idle.length;st.idle[id]=idx;ssNpcSaveState();}
  showLine();
 };
 $('ssNpcHintBtn').onclick=()=>{mode='hint';idx=0;showLine();};
 if(npc.story)$('ssNpcStoryBtn').onclick=()=>{ssNpcStopVoice();ssM1Talk(npc.story);};
 showLine();
}
window.__sandstarNpc={version:'npc-p0-noquest-20261118',base:SS_NPC_VOICE_BASE,saveKey:SS_NPC_SAVE_KEY,data:SS_NPC_DATA,state:()=>ssNpcState,talk:ssNpcTalk,stopVoice:ssNpcStopVoice,flat:ssNpcFlat};
function ssM1Act(){
 const choice=ssM1NearbyAction();if(!choice)return false;
 if(choice.act==='arch-enter')return archWorldTryEnter();
  if(choice.act==='crystal')return ssM1InspectCrystal();
 if(choice.act==='enter')return ssM16RequestTravel('life_forest_01');
 if(choice.act==='exit'||choice.act==='mine-exit')return ssM16RequestTravel(TOWN_WORLD_ID);
 if(choice.act==='mine-enter')return ssM16RequestTravel('mine');
 if(choice.act==='spring')return ssM1SpringMenu();
 if(choice.act==='harin'||choice.act==='seon')return ssM1Talk(choice.act);
 if(typeof choice.act==='string'&&choice.act.startsWith('npc-'))return ssNpcTalk(choice.act.slice(4));
 if(choice.act==='m17-object')return ssM17DoAction(choice.targetId);
 const name=choice.act==='market'?'town':choice.act;
 livingActiveTab=name==='town'?'town':name;livingMenu();return true;
}
$('m1ActionBtn').addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();ssM1Act();});
window.__sandstarHUDM15={get:()=>({scene:ssM15Scene,manualMining:ssM15ManualMining,base:ssM15BaseScene(),region:ssRegion,questExpanded:ssM15QuestExpanded,saveKey:SAVE_KEY}),toggleTool:ssM15ToggleToolMode,sync:ssM15SyncScene,setTestPosition:(x,y)=>{p.x=x;p.y=y;p.vx=p.vy=0;ssM15ManualMining=false;ssM15Scene='';updHud();}};

// ============================================================
// SANDSTAR FARM WORLD M2.0: true independently simulated top-down map.
// Not a popup: its viewport, player, collision, camera, input and worldId
// replace the legacy side-view scene until the physical gate is used.
// Legacy ssRegion remains life_forest_01 in the suspended side-view adapter.
// ============================================================
const FARM_WORLD_ID='farm_01', FARM_FOREST_GATE_X=28, FARM_W=46, FARM_H=32, FARM_TILE=32;
const FARM_PLOTS=Object.freeze([{id:'plot:34',x:18,y:15},{id:'plot:37',x:24,y:15},{id:'plot:40',x:30,y:15}]);
const farmRoot=$('farmWorldRoot'),farmCanvas=$('farmWorldCanvas'),farmCtx=farmCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});
let farmWorldActive=false,farmFrame=0,farmPlayer={x:6.5,y:16.5,face:'down'},farmCamera={x:0,y:0},farmSelectedSeed='wheat',farmMoveKeys=new Set(),farmPointer=null,farmJoystick={x:0,y:0},farmActionCount=0,farmChangeTimer=0,farmToastUntil=0,farmLastEnter=0;
let farmCanvasW=0,farmCanvasH=0,farmCanvasDpr=1,farmCommandSeq=0;
function farmWorldNormalize(raw){
 const d={schema:1,activeWorldId:ssRegion,position:{x:6.5,y:16.5},entryCount:0};
 if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw))return d;
 if(raw.activeWorldId===FARM_WORLD_ID)d.activeWorldId=FARM_WORLD_ID;
 if(raw.position&&Number.isFinite(raw.position.x)&&Number.isFinite(raw.position.y)){
  const x=Math.max(2.5,Math.min(FARM_W-2.5,raw.position.x)),y=Math.max(2.5,Math.min(FARM_H-2.5,raw.position.y));
  if(!farmWorldBlocked(x,y))d.position={x,y};
 }
 d.entryCount=Number.isSafeInteger(raw.entryCount)?Math.min(100000,Math.max(0,raw.entryCount)):0;
 return d;
}
function farmWorldBlocked(x,y){
 if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(y)||x<1.4||y<1.4||x>FARM_W-2.4||y>FARM_H-2.4)return true;
 const rect=(x1,y1,x2,y2)=>x>x1&&x<x2&&y>y1&&y<y2;
 if(rect(8,4,15,10)||rect(33,4,41,11)||rect(34,22,43,30)||rect(4,22,8,27))return true;
 for(const [tx,ty] of [[12,24],[16,25],[40,16],[7,30],[43,12],[17,4]])if(Math.hypot(x-tx,y-ty)<.83)return true;
 return false;
}
function farmWorldInitState(){game.farmWorldV1=farmWorldNormalize(game?.farmWorldV1);return game.farmWorldV1;}
function farmWorldNearbyGate(){return Math.hypot(farmPlayer.x-3.9,farmPlayer.y-16.5)<3.1;}
function farmWorldNearPlot(){
 let best=null,dist=Infinity;
 for(const o of FARM_PLOTS){let d=Math.hypot(farmPlayer.x-o.x,farmPlayer.y-o.y);if(d<dist){best=o;dist=d;}}
 return dist<=3.15?best:null;
}
function farmWorldNearForestGate(){return !!p&&!!game&&!paused&&!ssM16TransitionLocked&&ssRegion==='life_forest_01'&&ssM15Scene!=='mining'&&Math.abs(p.x-FARM_FOREST_GATE_X)<=2.8&&Math.abs(p.y-(terrain(FARM_FOREST_GATE_X)-1))<=2.8;}
function farmWorldSyncForestGate(){
 const b=$('farmForestGateAction');if(!b)return;
 b.hidden=!farmWorldNearForestGate();
}
$('farmForestGateAction').addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();farmWorldTryEnter();});
function farmWorldDrawForestPortal(){
 if(!game||ssRegion!=='life_forest_01')return;
 const sx=Math.round(FARM_FOREST_GATE_X*T-camera.x),sy=Math.round((terrain(FARM_FOREST_GATE_X)-1)*T-camera.y);
 if(sx<-75||sx>viewW+75)return;
 const near=farmWorldNearForestGate();ctx.save();
 ctx.fillStyle='#60452e';ctx.fillRect(sx-16,sy-48,8,51);ctx.fillRect(sx+22,sy-48,8,51);
 ctx.fillStyle='#bfa474';ctx.fillRect(sx-18,sy-49,50,9);
 ctx.fillStyle=near?'#fff3ab':'#edffdb';ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText(near?'E · 도래 농장 입장':'🌾 농장 길 →',sx+5,sy-62);
 if(near){ctx.globalAlpha=.24;ctx.fillStyle='#f5e9b1';ctx.fillRect(sx-23,sy-52,58,55);}
 ctx.restore();
}
function farmWorldTryForestTap(q){
 if(ssRegion!=='life_forest_01'||!q)return false;
 const y=terrain(FARM_FOREST_GATE_X)-1;
 if(Math.abs(q.x+.5-FARM_FOREST_GATE_X)>1.7||q.y<y-3.1||q.y>y+1)return false;
 if(!farmWorldNearForestGate()){flash('농장 출입구 가까이 가서 이용해 주세요');return true;}
 farmWorldTryEnter();return true;
}
function farmWorldClearInput(){farmMoveKeys.clear();farmJoystick={x:0,y:0};farmPointer=null;}
function farmWorldActivate(){
 farmWorldActive=true;farmRoot.hidden=false;$('app').classList.add('farm-world-active');
 farmWorldClearInput();ssM15ResetHeldInputs();releaseRope();
 const state=farmWorldInitState();farmPlayer.x=state.position.x;farmPlayer.y=state.position.y;
 farmWorldResize();farmWorldRefreshHud();
 void ssBgmSwitchRegion(FARM_WORLD_ID); // farm subworld: ssRegion stays forest, switch explicitly
 }
function farmWorldDeactivate(){
 farmWorldClearInput();farmWorldActive=false;farmRoot.hidden=true;$('app').classList.remove('farm-world-active');
 ssM15ResetHeldInputs();last=performance.now();
 void ssBgmSwitchRegion('life_forest_01'); // back to the forest theme
 }
function farmWorldEnterCore(){
 if(farmWorldActive)return false;
 if(!saveGame(true)){flash('진입 전 저장에 실패했어요. 월드는 유지됩니다.');return false;}
 const prev=game.farmWorldV1?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(game.farmWorldV1)):null;
 const state=farmWorldInitState();state.activeWorldId=FARM_WORLD_ID;state.entryCount++;
 if(!saveGame(true)){
  if(prev)game.farmWorldV1=prev;else delete game.farmWorldV1;
  flash('농장 저장에 실패했어요. 진입하지 않았습니다.');return false;
 }
 farmWorldActivate();farmLastEnter=performance.now();farmWorldToast('도래 농장에 도착했어요. 밭까지 걸어가 보세요!');return true;
}
function farmWorldExitCore(){
 if(!farmWorldActive||!farmWorldNearbyGate()){farmWorldToast('서쪽 출입구로 가까이 가야 돌아갈 수 있어요');return false;}
 const state=farmWorldInitState(),old=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state));
 const oldPlayer={x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:p.vx,vy:p.vy};
 state.position={x:farmPlayer.x,y:farmPlayer.y};state.activeWorldId='life_forest_01';
 p.x=FARM_FOREST_GATE_X+.5;p.y=terrain(p.x)-1;p.vx=p.vy=0;
 if(collides(p.x,p.y)){p.x=FARM_FOREST_GATE_X+1.5;p.y=terrain(p.x)-1;}
 if(collides(p.x,p.y)||!saveGame(true)){
  game.farmWorldV1=old;Object.assign(p,oldPlayer);farmWorldToast('저장 또는 안전 위치 확인에 실패해 농장에 머무릅니다');return false;
 }
 farmWorldDeactivate();updHud();flash('잔빛숲으로 돌아왔어요');return true;
}
function farmWorldTryEnter(){
 if(!farmWorldNearForestGate()||farmWorldActive||performance.now()-farmLastEnter<420||m25bBusy)return false;
 return m25bTransition(FARM_WORLD_ID,'farm-enter',farmWorldEnterCore,'life_forest_01');
}
function farmWorldTryExit(){
 if(!farmWorldActive||!farmWorldNearbyGate()||m25bBusy){
  if(farmWorldActive&&!m25bBusy)farmWorldToast('서쪽 출입구로 가까이 가야 돌아갈 수 있어요');
  return false;
 }
 return m25bTransition('life_forest_01','farm-exit',farmWorldExitCore,FARM_WORLD_ID);
}
function farmWorldRestoreAfterContinue(){
 if(!game||ssIsTitle())return;
 const state=farmWorldInitState();
 if(state.activeWorldId===FARM_WORLD_ID){farmWorldActivate();farmWorldToast('농장에서 이어서 시작합니다');}
}
function farmWorldToast(message){const t=$('farmWorldToast');t.textContent=message;t.classList.add('show');farmToastUntil=performance.now()+2400;}
function farmWorldActionLabel(){
 if(farmWorldNearbyGate())return '🚪 잔빛숲으로 나가기';
 const near=farmWorldNearPlot();if(!near)return '🌾 밭으로 이동하세요';
 const plot=game?.livingP0?.plots?.[near.id];if(!plot)return '🌾 경작 준비 중';
 if(plot.plantedAt===null)return '🌱 '+LIVING_CROPS[farmSelectedSeed].name+' 심기';
 if(!plot.watered)return '💧 물 주기';
 const t=plot.crop==='legacy'?90:(LIVING_CROPS[plot.crop]?.seconds||90);
 const remaining=t-(game.livingP0.clock-plot.plantedAt);
 return remaining>0?'🌿 성장 중 '+Math.ceil(remaining)+'초':'🌾 수확하기';
}
function farmWorldRefreshHud(){
 if(!game||!farmWorldActive)return;
 const bag=game.livingP0.bag;
 $('farmWorldBag').textContent=`🌱 밀 ${bag.seed_wheat} · 감자 ${bag.seed_potato} · 당근 ${bag.seed_carrot}`;
 $('farmWorldCoords').textContent=`X ${Math.floor(farmPlayer.x)} · Y ${Math.floor(farmPlayer.y)} · ${FARM_WORLD_ID}`;
 const btn=$('farmWorldAction');btn.textContent=farmWorldActionLabel();btn.disabled=!farmWorldNearPlot()&&!farmWorldNearbyGate();
 $('farmWorldExit').hidden=!farmWorldNearbyGate();
 const near=farmWorldNearPlot();$('farmWorldSub').textContent=near?`농장 ${near.id.replace('plot:','')}번 밭 · ${farmWorldActionLabel().replace(/^[^ ]+ /,'')}`:'자유롭게 이동하며 밭과 출입구를 찾으세요';
}
function farmWorldCommand(type,target,item){
 const cmd={id:'farm-'+Date.now()+'-'+(++farmCommandSeq),type,target,item};
 const tx=livingTargetX(target);if(tx===null)return false;
 // The existing P1.1 command engine operates on canonical legacy plot IDs.
 // Farm player proximity is validated in independent world coordinates FIRST.
 const r=applyLivingCommandPure(game.livingP0,cmd,{x:tx,y:76,groundY:76,inv:game.inv,coins:game.coins,seed:game.seed});
 if(!r.ok){farmWorldToast(r.reason);return false;}
 const prevState=game.livingP0,prevInv=game.inv,prevCoins=game.coins;
 game.livingP0=r.state;game.inv=r.inv;game.coins=r.coins;
 if(!saveGame(true)){game.livingP0=prevState;game.inv=prevInv;game.coins=prevCoins;farmWorldToast('저장 실패: 작업이 취소되고 자원이 복구됐어요');return false;}
 farmActionCount++;farmWorldRefreshHud();farmWorldToast(r.message);return true;
}
function farmWorldAction(){
 if(!farmWorldActive||m25bBusy)return false;
 if(farmWorldNearbyGate())return farmWorldTryExit();
 const near=farmWorldNearPlot();if(!near){farmWorldToast('밭 옆으로 이동하면 작업할 수 있어요');return false;}
 const plot=game.livingP0.plots[near.id];
 if(plot.plantedAt===null)return farmWorldCommand('plot.plant',near.id,farmSelectedSeed);
 if(!plot.watered)return farmWorldCommand('plot.water',near.id);
 return farmWorldCommand('plot.harvest',near.id);
}
$('farmWorldAction').addEventListener('click',farmWorldAction);
$('farmWorldExit').addEventListener('click',farmWorldTryExit);
$('farmSeedSelector').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-farm-seed]');if(!b)return;
 farmSelectedSeed=b.dataset.farmSeed;
 for(const x of $('farmSeedSelector').querySelectorAll('button'))x.classList.toggle('selected',x===b);
 farmWorldRefreshHud();});
function farmWorldResize(){
 const r=farmCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();farmCanvasW=r.width;farmCanvasH=r.height;
 farmCanvasDpr=Math.min(devicePixelRatio||1,2);farmCanvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.width*farmCanvasDpr));farmCanvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(r.height*farmCanvasDpr));
 farmCtx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
}
function farmWorldMoveDelta(){
 if(m25bBusy)return {x:0,y:0};
 let dx=(farmMoveKeys.has('d')||farmMoveKeys.has('arrowright')?1:0)-(farmMoveKeys.has('a')||farmMoveKeys.has('arrowleft')?1:0);
 let dy=(farmMoveKeys.has('s')||farmMoveKeys.has('arrowdown')?1:0)-(farmMoveKeys.has('w')||farmMoveKeys.has('arrowup')?1:0);
 dx+=farmJoystick.x;dy+=farmJoystick.y;let n=Math.hypot(dx,dy);return n>1?{x:dx/n,y:dy/n}:{x:dx,y:dy};
}
function farmWorldTick(dt){
 if(!game||ssIsTitle())return;
 if(m25bBusy){farmWorldDraw();return;}
 if(farmToastUntil&&performance.now()>farmToastUntil){$('farmWorldToast').classList.remove('show');farmToastUntil=0;}
 farmFrame++;
 const vec=farmWorldMoveDelta();const delta=Math.min(.05,dt)*4.7;
 for(const axis of ['x','y']){
  const v=vec[axis]*delta;if(!v)continue;
  const next={...farmPlayer,[axis]:farmPlayer[axis]+v};
  const rad=.31;
  if(![[-rad,-rad],[rad,-rad],[-rad,rad],[rad,rad]].some(([ox,oy])=>farmWorldBlocked(next.x+ox,next.y+oy)))farmPlayer[axis]+=v;
 }
 if(Math.abs(vec.x)+Math.abs(vec.y)>.1)farmPlayer.face=Math.abs(vec.x)>Math.abs(vec.y)?vec.x>0?'right':'left':vec.y>0?'down':'up';
 livingWorldTick(Math.max(0,dt)); // crops mature while playing in the new world
 farmChangeTimer+=dt;
 if(farmChangeTimer>.25){farmChangeTimer=0;farmWorldRefreshHud();}
 if(farmFrame%270===0){game.farmWorldV1.position={x:farmPlayer.x,y:farmPlayer.y};saveGame(true);}
 farmWorldDraw();
}
const farmRand=(x,y,k=1)=>{let a=Math.sin((x*113+y*241+k*37)*12.9898)*43758.5453;return a-Math.floor(a);};
function farmWorldDraw(){
 if(!farmCanvasW||!farmCanvasH)farmWorldResize();
 const c=farmCtx,t=FARM_TILE,W=farmCanvasW,H=farmCanvasH;
 c.setTransform(farmCanvasDpr,0,0,farmCanvasDpr,0,0);c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 c.fillStyle='#85b990';c.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
 farmCamera.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.max(0,FARM_W*t-W),farmPlayer.x*t-W*.5));
 farmCamera.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(Math.max(0,FARM_H*t-H),farmPlayer.y*t-H*.51));
 c.save();c.translate(-Math.round(farmCamera.x),-Math.round(farmCamera.y));
 const x0=Math.max(0,Math.floor(farmCamera.x/t)-1),x1=Math.min(FARM_W-1,Math.ceil((farmCamera.x+W)/t)+1);
 const y0=Math.max(0,Math.floor(farmCamera.y/t)-1),y1=Math.min(FARM_H-1,Math.ceil((farmCamera.y+H)/t)+1);
 const path=(x,y)=>(y>=15&&y<=17&&x>=3&&x<=37)||(x>=19&&x<=21&&y>=6&&y<=26)||(x>=11&&x<=13&&y>=10&&y<=17);
 for(let y=y0;y<=y1;y++)for(let x=x0;x<=x1;x++){
  const px=x*t,py=y*t,road=path(x,y);c.fillStyle=road?((x+y)%2?'#baae80':'#c6b78e'):(farmRand(x,y)>.55?'#82b98a':'#8cc497');c.fillRect(px,py,t,t);
  if(road){c.fillStyle='#e0cf9c';if(farmRand(x,y,9)>.66)c.fillRect(px+8,py+11,4,2);}else{
   const r=farmRand(x,y);if(r>.79){c.fillStyle='#568b5b';c.fillRect(px+7,py+8,3,9);c.fillRect(px+21,py+22,4,5);}if(r<.12){c.fillStyle='#fff3bb';c.fillRect(px+13,py+13,3,3);} }
 }
 // Outer fence with visible western farm gate; fence has physical collision along map bounds.
 for(let x=1;x<FARM_W-1;x++){farmDrawFence(c,x,1,'horizontal');farmDrawFence(c,x,FARM_H-2,'horizontal');}
 for(let y=1;y<FARM_H-1;y++){if(y<14||y>18)farmDrawFence(c,1,y,'vertical');farmDrawFence(c,FARM_W-2,y,'vertical');}
 // Barn, farmhouse, woodland, pond, orchard and crop plots are actual spatial entities.
 farmDrawHouse(c,8,4,7,6,'🏡 농장 주택','#a96e59');
 farmDrawHouse(c,33,4,8,7,'🏚️ 창고','#805c56');
 // Pond with bordered reeds; solid collision handled by farmWorldBlocked.
 for(let y=22;y<30;y++)for(let x=34;x<43;x++){
  c.fillStyle=farmRand(x,y,7)>.5?'#488f9a':'#559da2';c.fillRect(x*t,y*t,t,t);
  if(farmRand(x,y,21)>.83){c.fillStyle='#bddcd1';c.fillRect(x*t+9,y*t+14,9,2);}
 }
 for(const [x,y] of [[6,25],[12,24],[16,25],[40,16],[7,30],[43,12],[17,4]])farmDrawTree(c,x,y);
 for(const o of FARM_PLOTS)farmDrawPlot(c,o);
 // signposts and a separate in-world west portal
 farmDrawPortal(c,3.9,16.5);

// Touch/mouse canvas selects only nearby plots or west gate, never remote interaction.

 if(o){if(Math.hypot(farmPlayer.x-o.x,farmPlayer.y-o.y)>3.15){farmWorldToast('밭 가까이 가서 손질해 주세요');return;}farmWorldAction();}
});
// Joystick uses pointer ownership and clears it on cancel/blur/world exit.
function farmSetJoystick(e){const r=$('farmDpad').getBoundingClientRect(),dx=(e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)/(r.width*.34),dy=(e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)/(r.height*.34),n=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));farmJoystick={x:dx/n,y:dy/n};}
$('farmDpad').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!farmWorldActive||m25bBusy||farmPointer!==null)return;e.preventDefault();farmPointer=e.pointerId;try{e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}farmSetJoystick(e)});

 tryEnter:farmWorldTryEnter,exit:farmWorldTryExit,action:farmWorldAction,chooseSeed:id=>{if(!LIVING_CROPS[id])return false;farmSelectedSeed=id;farmWorldRefreshHud();return true},
 testMove:(x,y)=>{if(!farmWorldActive||farmWorldBlocked(x,y))return false;farmPlayer.x=x;farmPlayer.y=y;game.farmWorldV1.position={x,y};farmWorldRefreshHud();farmWorldDraw();return true},

// M2.1: RUINS_3D_01 independent 3D WORLD adapter.

// CPU 3D perspective fallback for browsers that cannot create WebGL context.
// ============================================================
const ARCH_WORLD_ID='ruins_3d_01', ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X=134;
const archRoot=$('archWorldRoot'),archGpuCanvas=$('archWorldGpu'),archFallbackCanvas=$('archWorldFallback');
let archWorldActive=false,archPlayer={x:0,z:12},archYaw=0.18,archPitch=.49,archFrame=0,archElapsed=0,archLastEnter=0;
let archKeys=new Set(),archJoy={x:0,y:0},archJoyPointer=null,archDrag=null,archRenderer='uninitialized',archToastEnd=0,archSaveTick=0;
let archW=0,archH=0,archDpr=1,archGl=null,archProgram=null,archBuffer=null,archGlPosition=-1,archGlColor=-1,archCpuCtx=null;
const archStatic=[];
const archColors={earth:[38,57,65],tile:[68,90,93],tileAlt:[53,78,82],wall:[86,107,112],wallDark:[56,77,83],pillar:[122,139,140],pillarLight:[149,161,154],metal:[126,110,89],bronze:[177,142,93],teal:[43,170,177],light:[107,231,222],gold:[227,188,111],stone:[94,114,121],shard:[73,208,214],red:[171,89,89],void:[24,40,53]};
function archWorldBlocked(x,z){
 if(!Number.isFinite(x)||!Number.isFinite(z)||Math.abs(x)>12.65||Math.abs(z)>18.25)return true;
 const rect=(a,b,c,d)=>x>a&&x<c&&z>b&&z<d;
 for(const cx of [-7.8,7.8])for(const cz of [9.3,1.3,-6.7,-13.3])if(Math.hypot(x-cx,z-cz)<.9)return true;
 if(rect(-3.35,-14.85,3.35,-10.05)||rect(-9.6,-2.35,-7.1,.2)||rect(7.3,-10.1,9.7,-8.0))return true;
 return false;
}
function archWorldNormalize(raw){
 const d={schema:1,activeWorldId:'life_forest_01',position:{x:0,z:12},entryCount:0,cameraYaw:.18};
 if(!raw||typeof raw!=='object'||Array.isArray(raw))return d;
 if(raw.activeWorldId===ARCH_WORLD_ID)d.activeWorldId=ARCH_WORLD_ID;
 if(raw.position&&Number.isFinite(raw.position.x)&&Number.isFinite(raw.position.z)){
  const x=Math.max(-12.2,Math.min(12.2,raw.position.x));const z=Math.max(-17.8,Math.min(17.8,raw.position.z));
  if(!archWorldBlocked(x,z))d.position={x,z};
 }
 if(Number.isFinite(raw.cameraYaw))d.cameraYaw=Math.max(-100,Math.min(100,raw.cameraYaw));
 if(Number.isSafeInteger(raw.entryCount))d.entryCount=Math.max(0,Math.min(100000,raw.entryCount));
 return d;
}
function archWorldInitState(){game.archWorldV1=archWorldNormalize(game?.archWorldV1);return game.archWorldV1;}
function archWorldNearForestGate(){
 return !!p&&!!game&&!paused&&!farmWorldActive&&!archWorldActive&&!ssM16TransitionLocked&&ssRegion==='life_forest_01'&&ssM15Scene!=='mining'&&Math.abs(p.x-ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X)<=2.85&&Math.abs(p.y-(terrain(ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X)-1))<=2.8;
}
function archWorldDrawForestPortal(){
 if(!game||ssRegion!=='life_forest_01')return;
 const x=Math.round(ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X*T-camera.x),foot=Math.round((terrain(ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X)-1)*T-camera.y);
 if(x<-100||x>viewW+100)return;
 const near=archWorldNearForestGate();ctx.save();
 ctx.fillStyle='#607984';ctx.fillRect(x-27,foot-65,11,67);ctx.fillRect(x+16,foot-65,11,67);ctx.fillStyle='#9eabb0';ctx.fillRect(x-27,foot-67,54,11);
 ctx.fillStyle='#18353d';ctx.fillRect(x-15,foot-52,30,50);ctx.fillStyle='#56acb4';ctx.fillRect(x-10,foot-47,20,43);ctx.globalAlpha=.48+.15*Math.sin(frame*.06);ctx.fillStyle='#a8f5e9';ctx.fillRect(x-8,foot-45,16,40);ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 ctx.font='bold 12px system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillStyle=near?'#fff0b9':'#e1fcf3';ctx.fillText(near?'E · 3D 유적으로':'✦ 유적 입구',x,foot-77);
 ctx.restore();
}
function archWorldTryForestTap(q){
 if(!q||ssRegion!=='life_forest_01'||archWorldActive||farmWorldActive)return false;
 let y=terrain(ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X)-1;
 if(Math.abs(q.x+.5-ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X)>1.65||q.y<y-3.7||q.y>y+1)return false;
 if(!archWorldNearForestGate()){flash('유적 입구로 가까이 이동하세요');return true;}
 archWorldTryEnter();return true;
}
function archWorldClearInput(){archKeys.clear();archJoy={x:0,y:0};archJoyPointer=null;archDrag=null;}
function archWorldNotify(msg){let t=$('archWorldToast');t.textContent=msg;t.classList.add('show');archToastEnd=performance.now()+2400;}
function archWorldActivate(){
 if(archWorldActive)return;
 archWorldActive=true;archRoot.hidden=false;$('app').classList.add('arch-world-active');
 archWorldClearInput();ssM15ResetHeldInputs();releaseRope();
 const s=archWorldInitState();archPlayer.x=s.position.x;archPlayer.z=s.position.z;archYaw=s.cameraYaw;
 archWorldInitRenderer();archWorldResize();archWorldRefreshHud();archWorldDraw();
 void ssBgmSwitchRegion(ARCH_WORLD_ID); // ruins subworld: ssRegion stays forest, switch explicitly
 }
function archWorldDeactivate(){
 archWorldClearInput();archWorldActive=false;archRoot.hidden=true;$('app').classList.remove('arch-world-active');
 ssM15ResetHeldInputs();last=performance.now();
 void ssBgmSwitchRegion('life_forest_01'); // back to the forest theme
 }
function archWorldEnterCore(){
 if(archWorldActive||farmWorldActive)return false;
 if(!saveGame(true)){flash('저장 실패: 현재 지역을 유지합니다');return false;}
 const prev=game.archWorldV1?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(game.archWorldV1)):null;
 const s=archWorldInitState();s.activeWorldId=ARCH_WORLD_ID;s.entryCount++;
 if(!saveGame(true)){
  if(prev)game.archWorldV1=prev;else delete game.archWorldV1;
  flash('저장 실패: 유적 진입을 취소했어요');return false;
 }
 archWorldActivate();archLastEnter=performance.now();archWorldNotify('별맥 유적에 진입했습니다. 3D 공간을 걸어보세요.');return true;
}
function archWorldNearExit(){return Math.hypot(archPlayer.x,archPlayer.z-15.5)<2.75;}
function archWorldNearExhibit(){return Math.hypot(archPlayer.x+6.2,archPlayer.z+6.6)<2.65||Math.hypot(archPlayer.x,archPlayer.z+8.25)<2.8;}
function archWorldExitCore(){
 if(!archWorldActive||!archWorldNearExit()){archWorldNotify('남쪽의 빛나는 출입구로 돌아가세요');return false;}
 const s=archWorldInitState(),old=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(s)),oldP={x:p.x,y:p.y,vx:p.vx,vy:p.vy};
 s.position={x:archPlayer.x,z:archPlayer.z};s.cameraYaw=archYaw;s.activeWorldId='life_forest_01';
 p.x=ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X+.4;p.y=terrain(p.x)-1;p.vx=p.vy=0;
 if(collides(p.x,p.y)){p.x=ARCH_FOREST_GATE_X-1.3;p.y=terrain(p.x)-1;}
 if(collides(p.x,p.y)||!saveGame(true)){
  game.archWorldV1=old;Object.assign(p,oldP);archWorldNotify('출입구 또는 저장 검증에 실패했어요');return false;
 }
 archWorldDeactivate();updHud();flash('잔빛숲으로 돌아왔어요');return true;
}
function archWorldTryEnter(){
 if(!archWorldNearForestGate()||archWorldActive||farmWorldActive||performance.now()-archLastEnter<400||m25bBusy)return false;
 return m25bTransition(ARCH_WORLD_ID,'ruins-enter',archWorldEnterCore,'life_forest_01');
}
function archWorldTryExit(){
 if(!archWorldActive||!archWorldNearExit()||m25bBusy){
  if(archWorldActive&&!m25bBusy)archWorldNotify('남쪽의 빛나는 출입구로 돌아가세요');
  return false;
 }
 return m25bTransition('life_forest_01','ruins-exit',archWorldExitCore,ARCH_WORLD_ID);
}
function archWorldRestoreAfterContinue(){
 if(!game||ssIsTitle())return;
 let s=archWorldInitState();
 if(s.activeWorldId===ARCH_WORLD_ID){archWorldActivate();archWorldNotify('별맥 유적에서 이어서 시작합니다.');}
}
function archWorldAction(){
 if(!archWorldActive||m25bBusy)return false;
 if(archWorldNearExit())return archWorldTryExit();
 if(archWorldNearExhibit()){archWorldNotify('유적 조사는 화면 전환 실험용입니다. 보상·퀘스트는 변경되지 않아요.');return true;}
 archWorldNotify('이동하며 유적의 길·기둥·카메라를 살펴보세요');return false;
}
function archWorldRefreshHud(){
 if(!game||!archWorldActive)return;
 let label=archWorldNearExit()?'🚪 잔빛숲으로 돌아가기':archWorldNearExhibit()?'⌕ 유적 흔적 조사':'✦ 유적 둘러보기';
 $('archWorldAction').textContent=label;$('archWorldAction').disabled=!archWorldNearExit()&&!archWorldNearExhibit();
 $('archWorldHint').textContent=archWorldNearExit()?'출입구 가까이 있습니다 · E로 귀환':archWorldNearExhibit()?'빛나는 흔적을 조사할 수 있습니다':'길을 따라 유적 안쪽으로 이동해 보세요';
 $('archWorldPosition').textContent=`X ${archPlayer.x.toFixed(1)} · Z ${archPlayer.z.toFixed(1)}`;
 $('archWorldMode').textContent=archRenderer==='webgl'?'WebGL · 3D 공간':'소프트웨어 · 3D 공간';
}
$('archWorldAction').addEventListener('click',archWorldAction);
$('archCameraReset').addEventListener('click',()=>{archYaw=.18;archPitch=.49;archWorldDraw();});
function archWorldMovement(){
 if(m25bBusy)return {x:0,z:0};
 let x=(archKeys.has('d')||archKeys.has('arrowright')?1:0)-(archKeys.has('a')||archKeys.has('arrowleft')?1:0);
 let f=(archKeys.has('w')||archKeys.has('arrowup')?1:0)-(archKeys.has('s')||archKeys.has('arrowdown')?1:0);
 x+=archJoy.x;f-=archJoy.y;
 let length=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(x,f));x/=length;f/=length;
 // Screen-relative motion must use the exact same ground-plane basis as archCameraSetup:
 // camera.right=(cos(yaw), 0, -sin(yaw)), camera.forward=(-sin(yaw), 0, -cos(yaw)).
 // In M2.4, +f*sin(yaw) reversed forward X whenever the camera rotated.
 const cy=Math.cos(archYaw),sy=Math.sin(archYaw);
 return {x:x*cy-f*sy,z:-x*sy-f*cy};
}
function archWorldTick(dt){
 if(!archWorldActive||!game||ssIsTitle())return;
 if(m25bBusy){archWorldDraw();return;}
 const move=archWorldMovement(),delta=Math.min(.05,dt)*5;
 for(const axis of ['x','z']){const next={...archPlayer,[axis]:archPlayer[axis]+move[axis]*delta};
  if(![[-.31,-.31],[.31,-.31],[-.31,.31],[.31,.31]].some(([a,b])=>archWorldBlocked(next.x+a,next.z+b)))archPlayer[axis]+=move[axis]*delta;
 }
 archElapsed+=dt;archFrame++;
 if(archToastEnd&&performance.now()>archToastEnd){$('archWorldToast').classList.remove('show');archToastEnd=0;}
 if(archFrame%12===0)archWorldRefreshHud();
 archSaveTick+=dt;
 if(archSaveTick>5){archSaveTick=0;saveGame(true);}
 archWorldDraw();
}
// Geometry generation: intentional simple untextured proxy ruins, no external assets.
function archColor(c){return archColors[c]||c;}
function archAddTriangle(out,a,b,c,color){out.push({v:[a,b,c],color:archColor(color)});}
function archBox(out,x,y,z,w,h,d,color){
 const x0=x-w/2,x1=x+w/2,y0=y,y1=y+h,z0=z-d/2,z1=z+d/2;
 const V=[[x0,y0,z0],[x1,y0,z0],[x1,y0,z1],[x0,y0,z1],[x0,y1,z0],[x1,y1,z0],[x1,y1,z1],[x0,y1,z1]];
 for(const [a,b,c,d] of [[3,2,1,0],[4,5,6,7],[0,1,5,4],[1,2,6,5],[2,3,7,6],[3,0,4,7]]){
  archAddTriangle(out,V[a],V[b],V[c],color);archAddTriangle(out,V[a],V[c],V[d],color);
 }
}
function archPyramid(out,x,y,z,r,h,color){
 let verts=[];for(let i=0;i<4;i++){let a=i*Math.PI/2+Math.PI/4;verts.push([x+Math.sin(a)*r,y,z+Math.cos(a)*r]);}
 for(let i=0;i<4;i++)archAddTriangle(out,verts[i],verts[(i+1)%4],[x,y+h,z],color);
}
function archCylinder(out,x,y,z,r,h,color,sides=9){
 const c=archColor(color);for(let i=0;i<sides;i++){let a=i*2*Math.PI/sides,b=(i+1)*2*Math.PI/sides;
  let lo=[x+Math.cos(a)*r,y,z+Math.sin(a)*r],ro=[x+Math.cos(b)*r,y,z+Math.sin(b)*r];
  let hi=[lo[0],y+h,lo[2]],hr=[ro[0],y+h,ro[2]];
  archAddTriangle(out,lo,ro,hr,c);archAddTriangle(out,lo,hr,hi,c);
  archAddTriangle(out,[x,y+h,z],hi,hr,c);
 }
}
function archMakeGeometry(){
 if(archStatic.length)return;
 for(let x=-12;x<13;x+=2)for(let z=-18;z<19;z+=2){
  archBox(archStatic,x, -.16,z,2.05,.16,2.05,((x*7+z*3)&4)?'tile':'tileAlt');
  if((x+z)%6===0)archBox(archStatic,x,-.01,z,1.35,.025,.025,'wallDark');
 }
 // Stone boundary: broken enough that the hall opens onto the void, still physically bounded.
 for(let z=-18;z<=18;z+=3){archBox(archStatic,-13.1,0,z,1.0,1.8,2.95,'wall');archBox(archStatic,13.1,0,z,1.0,1.8,2.95,'wall');}
 for(let x=-12;x<=12;x+=3){archBox(archStatic,x,0,-19,2.9,1.75,1,'wallDark');if(Math.abs(x)>2.3)archBox(archStatic,x,0,19,2.9,1.25,1,'wallDark');}
 for(const x of [-7.8,7.8])for(const z of [9.3,1.3,-6.7,-13.3]){
  archBox(archStatic,x,.0,z,2.6,.5,2.6,'stone');
  archCylinder(archStatic,x,.5,z,.75,3.85,'pillar');
  archBox(archStatic,x,4.35,z,2.35,.6,2.35,'pillarLight');
  archBox(archStatic,x,4.94,z,2.0,.25,2.0,'gold');
 }
 // Fragmented stone walkways, threshold, old machinery and real-world-size doorway.
 for(let z=16;z>-13;z-=4){archBox(archStatic,0,.025,z,5,.07,1.1,'metal');}
 archBox(archStatic,-4.25,0,16,1.0,2.35,1.0,'pillarLight');
 archBox(archStatic,4.25,0,16,1.0,2.35,1.0,'pillarLight');
 archPyramid(archStatic,-4.25,2.35,16,.7,.6,'shard');archPyramid(archStatic,4.25,2.35,16,.7,.6,'shard');
 archBox(archStatic,0,0,16,3,.06,2.2,'teal');
 archPyramid(archStatic,0,.05,16,1.2,.4,'light');
 // Vault north, pedestal and visual-only sigil, no gameplay reward.
 archBox(archStatic,0,0,-12.5,6.1,1.35,5.7,'wallDark');
 archBox(archStatic,0,1.35,-12.5,3.0,.5,3.2,'metal');
 archBox(archStatic,0,1.85,-12.5,1.6,.35,1.6,'bronze');
 archPyramid(archStatic,0,2.2,-12.5,1.2,2.5,'shard');
 archPyramid(archStatic,0,4.7,-12.5,.54,.7,'light');
 for(const [x,z] of [[-10,-3],[10,-10],[-8,13],[9,8]]){
  archBox(archStatic,x,0,z,2.1,.8,1.4,'wallDark');
  archBox(archStatic,x,.8,z,1.7,.4,1.2,'pillar');
 }
 archBox(archStatic,-4.2,0,4,2.0,1.0,2.0,'stone');
 archPyramid(archStatic,-4.2,1.0,4,.8,1.3,'teal');
 archBox(archStatic,4.2,0,3.5,2.0,1.0,2.0,'wallDark');
 archPyramid(archStatic,4.2,1.0,3.5,.7,1.1,'gold');
 // Excavation grid marks. This is scenery only; no new collection or reward.
 archBox(archStatic,-6.15,.02,-6.6,3.0,.035,3.0,'earth');
 for(let x=-7.4;x<=-4.8;x+=.85)archBox(archStatic,x,.07,-6.6,.05,.025,2.85,'bronze');
 for(let z=-7.85;z<=-5.25;z+=.85)archBox(archStatic,-6.15,.08,z,2.85,.025,.05,'bronze');
 archPyramid(archStatic,-6.15,.1,-6.6,.65,.55,'shard');
 for(let i=0;i<8;i++){let a=i*Math.PI/4,x=5.5+Math.cos(a)*1.6,z=-4.3+Math.sin(a)*1.6;
  archPyramid(archStatic,x,0,z,.6,.6,i%2?'bronze':'teal');
 }
}
function archCameraSetup(){
 const target=[archPlayer.x,1.2,archPlayer.z],radius=14.7;
 const eye=[target[0]+Math.sin(archYaw)*Math.cos(archPitch)*radius,target[1]+Math.sin(archPitch)*radius+2,target[2]+Math.cos(archYaw)*Math.cos(archPitch)*radius];
 const norm=a=>{const d=Math.hypot(...a)||1;return a.map(v=>v/d)};
 const forward=norm(target.map((v,i)=>v-eye[i]));
 const right=norm([-forward[2],0,forward[0]]); // right = cross(forward, world-up)
 const up=[right[1]*forward[2]-right[2]*forward[1],right[2]*forward[0]-right[0]*forward[2],right[0]*forward[1]-right[1]*forward[0]];
 return {eye,forward,right,up};
}
function archProject(p,cam){
 const d=p.map((x,i)=>x-cam.eye[i]);
 const dot=v=>d[0]*v[0]+d[1]*v[1]+d[2]*v[2];
 const depth=dot(cam.forward);if(depth<=.55)return null;
 const focal=Math.min(archW*1.35,archH*1.85),sx=archW*.5+dot(cam.right)*focal/depth,sy=archH*.56-dot(cam.up)*focal/depth;
 return {x:sx,y:sy,depth};
}
function archLitColor(t,depth){
 const [a,b,c]=t.v,ax=b[0]-a[0],ay=b[1]-a[1],az=b[2]-a[2],bx=c[0]-a[0],by=c[1]-a[1],bz=c[2]-a[2];
 let nx=ay*bz-az*by,ny=az*bx-ax*bz,nz=ax*by-ay*bx,len=Math.hypot(nx,ny,nz)||1;
 const light=Math.max(.48,Math.min(1.1, .84+(.18*nx+.65*ny+.5*nz)/len*.28));
 const fog=Math.max(0,Math.min(.56,(depth-15)/40));
 return t.color.map((v,i)=>Math.max(0,Math.min(255,Math.round(v*light*(1-fog)+[14,29,39][i]*fog))));
}
function archWorldGeometry(){
 archMakeGeometry();const dynamic=[];
 const p=archPlayer,walk=Math.sin(archElapsed*8)*.045;
 archBox(dynamic,p.x,0,p.z,.65,.28,.55,'metal');
 archBox(dynamic,p.x,.28+walk,p.z,.82,1.05,.48,'teal');
 archBox(dynamic,p.x,1.33+walk,p.z,.69,.67,.67,'pillarLight');
 archBox(dynamic,p.x,1.96+walk,p.z,.9,.18,.9,'bronze');
 archBox(dynamic,p.x,2.12+walk,p.z,.52,.35,.55,'metal');
 archBox(dynamic,p.x-.25,.12,p.z,.27,.38,.33,'wallDark');
 archBox(dynamic,p.x+.25,.12,p.z,.27,.38,.33,'wallDark');
 // Small orbiting spark at the restored ruins shrine.
 const t=archElapsed*.9;
 archPyramid(dynamic,.75*Math.sin(t),3.95+.12*Math.sin(t*2),-12.5+.75*Math.cos(t),.34,.65,'light');
 return archStatic.concat(dynamic);
}
function archShader(gl,type,src){let s=gl.createShader(type);gl.shaderSource(s,src);gl.compileShader(s);if(!gl.getShaderParameter(s,gl.COMPILE_STATUS))throw Error('shader:'+gl.getShaderInfoLog(s));return s;}
function archTryWebGL(){
 let gl;try{gl=archGpuCanvas.getContext('webgl',{antialias:true,alpha:false,depth:true,powerPreference:'low-power'});}catch(e){return false;}
 if(!gl)return false;
 try{
  let program=gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(program,archShader(gl,gl.VERTEX_SHADER,'attribute vec3 a_position; attribute vec3 a_color; varying vec3 v_color; void main(){ gl_Position=vec4(a_position,1.0); v_color=a_color;}'));
  gl.attachShader(program,archShader(gl,gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER,'precision mediump float; varying vec3 v_color; void main(){gl_FragColor=vec4(v_color,1.0);}'));
  gl.linkProgram(program);if(!gl.getProgramParameter(program,gl.LINK_STATUS))throw Error('link:'+gl.getProgramInfoLog(program));
  archGl=gl;archProgram=program;archBuffer=gl.createBuffer();archGlPosition=gl.getAttribLocation(program,'a_position');archGlColor=gl.getAttribLocation(program,'a_color');
  gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST);gl.depthFunc(gl.LEQUAL);gl.disable(gl.CULL_FACE);return true;
 }catch(err){console.warn('arch WebGL unavailable:',err);return false;}
}
function archWorldInitRenderer(){
 if(archRenderer!=='uninitialized')return;
 archRenderer=archTryWebGL()?'webgl':'cpu';
 if(archRenderer==='cpu'){archGpuCanvas.hidden=true;archFallbackCanvas.hidden=false;archCpuCtx=archFallbackCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});}
 archGpuCanvas.addEventListener('webglcontextlost',e=>{e.preventDefault();archRenderer='cpu';archGpuCanvas.hidden=true;archFallbackCanvas.hidden=false;archCpuCtx=archFallbackCanvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:false});archWorldResize();archWorldNotify('3D 그래픽이 중단되어 소프트웨어 3D로 전환했어요');},{once:true});
 archMakeGeometry();
}
function archWorldResize(){
 let r=archRoot.getBoundingClientRect();archW=r.width||window.innerWidth;archH=r.height||window.innerHeight;
 archDpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
 for(const canvas of [archGpuCanvas,archFallbackCanvas]){canvas.width=Math.max(1,Math.round(archW*archDpr));canvas.height=Math.max(1,Math.round(archH*archDpr));}
}
function archWorldDraw(){
 if(!archWorldActive)return;
 const rect=archRoot.getBoundingClientRect();
 if(!archW||!archH||Math.abs(rect.width-archW)>1||Math.abs(rect.height-archH)>1)archWorldResize();
 const cam=archCameraSetup(),faces=[];
 for(const tri of archWorldGeometry()){
  const vv=tri.v.map(v=>archProject(v,cam));if(vv.some(v=>!v))continue;
  const dep=vv.reduce((s,v)=>s+v.depth,0)/3;
  faces.push({v:vv,c:archLitColor(tri,dep),depth:dep});
 }
 if(archRenderer==='webgl'&&archGl){
  const gl=archGl;gl.viewport(0,0,archGpuCanvas.width,archGpuCanvas.height);gl.clearColor(.052,.115,.157,1);gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT|gl.DEPTH_BUFFER_BIT);
  const data=new Float32Array(faces.length*3*6);let i=0;
  for(const f of faces)for(const v of f.v){data[i++]=v.x/archW*2-1;data[i++]=1-v.y/archH*2;data[i++]=Math.min(.99,v.depth/85*2-1);data[i++]=f.c[0]/255;data[i++]=f.c[1]/255;data[i++]=f.c[2]/255;}
  gl.useProgram(archProgram);gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,archBuffer);gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER,data,gl.DYNAMIC_DRAW);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(archGlPosition);gl.vertexAttribPointer(archGlPosition,3,gl.FLOAT,false,24,0);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(archGlColor);gl.vertexAttribPointer(archGlColor,3,gl.FLOAT,false,24,12);
  gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES,0,faces.length*3);
 }else if(archCpuCtx){
  const c=archCpuCtx;c.setTransform(archDpr,0,0,archDpr,0,0);c.fillStyle='#0e2533';c.fillRect(0,0,archW,archH);
  const g=c.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,archH);g.addColorStop(0,'#102d40');g.addColorStop(1,'#10232b');c.fillStyle=g;c.fillRect(0,0,archW,archH);
  faces.sort((a,b)=>b.depth-a.depth);
  for(const f of faces){c.beginPath();c.moveTo(f.v[0].x,f.v[0].y);c.lineTo(f.v[1].x,f.v[1].y);c.lineTo(f.v[2].x,f.v[2].y);c.closePath();c.fillStyle=`rgb(${f.c.join(',')})`;c.fill();}
 }
}
function archJoystickSet(e){let r=$('archPad').getBoundingClientRect(),dx=(e.clientX-r.left-r.width/2)/(r.width*.36),dy=(e.clientY-r.top-r.height/2)/(r.height*.36),d=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));archJoy={x:dx/d,y:dy/d};}
$('archPad').addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{if(!archWorldActive||m25bBusy||archJoyPointer!==null)return;e.preventDefault();archJoyPointer=e.pointerId;try{e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}archJoystickSet(e);});
$('archPad').addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{if(archWorldActive&&archJoyPointer===e.pointerId){e.preventDefault();archJoystickSet(e);}});
for(const typ of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])$('archPad').addEventListener(typ,e=>{if(archJoyPointer===e.pointerId){archJoyPointer=null;archJoy={x:0,y:0};}});
function archPointerDown(e){if(!archWorldActive||archDrag||m25bBusy)return;e.preventDefault();archDrag={id:e.pointerId,x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY};try{e.currentTarget.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){};}
function archPointerMove(e){if(!archWorldActive||m25bBusy||!archDrag||archDrag.id!==e.pointerId)return;e.preventDefault();let dx=e.clientX-archDrag.x,dy=e.clientY-archDrag.y;archYaw-=dx*.007;archPitch=Math.max(.16,Math.min(.85,archPitch-dy*.003));archDrag.x=e.clientX;archDrag.y=e.clientY;}
function archPointerEnd(e){if(archDrag?.id===e.pointerId)archDrag=null;}
for(const c of [archGpuCanvas,archFallbackCanvas]){
 c.addEventListener('pointerdown',archPointerDown);c.addEventListener('pointermove',archPointerMove);
 for(const ev of ['pointerup','pointercancel','lostpointercapture'])c.addEventListener(ev,archPointerEnd);
}
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
 if(!archWorldActive||m25bBusy)return;const k=e.key.toLowerCase();
 if(['w','a','s','d','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright','e',' ','escape','q','r'].includes(k)){
  e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();
  if(['e',' '].includes(k)&&!e.repeat)archWorldAction();
  else if(k==='escape'&&!e.repeat)archWorldTryExit();
  else if(k==='q'&&!e.repeat){archYaw-=.32;}
  else if(k==='r'&&!e.repeat){archYaw+=.32;}
  else if(!['e',' ','escape','q','r'].includes(k))archKeys.add(k);
 }
},true);
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{if(!archWorldActive)return;let k=e.key.toLowerCase();archKeys.delete(k);if(['w','a','s','d','arrowup','arrowdown','arrowleft','arrowright'].includes(k)){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();}},true);
window.addEventListener('blur',archWorldClearInput);
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(archWorldActive){archWorldResize();archWorldDraw();}});

 setYaw:y=>{if(!Number.isFinite(y))return false;archYaw=y;archWorldDraw();return true},

};

async function t25Travel(t){
